title: Account Manager — Remote, Australian Client
description:
About the Role



We're hiring an Account Manager to look after an existing book of clients for an Australian business — keeping them happy, keeping them, and growing them.



This is a relationship role first and a sales role second. You'll be the person clients call when something needs sorting, the person who checks in before there's a problem, and the person who spots when a client is ready for more than they're currently buying. Retention and renewals are the core measure; account growth is the upside.



We're looking for someone dependable — the kind of account manager clients ask for by name because things get handled without being chased.



What You'll Be Doing



Managing a portfolio of existing client accounts as their day-to-day point of contact

Running regular check-ins and account reviews, and staying ahead of issues before they escalate

Coordinating internally to resolve client requests, delivery issues and escalations

Managing renewals, contract variations and pricing conversations

Identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts

Onboarding new clients handed over from the business development team

Maintaining accurate account records, notes and activity in the CRM

Reporting on account health, retention risk and growth opportunities



What We're Looking For



2+ years in account management, client services or customer success

Experience managing a portfolio of business clients, ideally in Australia, the US or UK

Excellent spoken and written English — you'll be handling difficult conversations as well as easy ones

Calm, solutions-focused approach when a client is unhappy

Confident with renewals, pricing discussions and commercial terms

Strong organisational skills — nothing falls through the cracks across multiple accounts

Experience with CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel or similar)

Reliable home internet, a quiet work environment and a good headset



Nice to Have



B2B services, IT, recruitment or professional services background

Experience with QBRs or structured account review cycles

Exposure to service delivery or operations as well as the client-facing side



About EAD Consultants



EAD Consultants is an Australian business and IT consulting and recruitment firm based in Penrith, NSW. We connect skilled Filipino professionals with Australian businesses across a range of industries, supporting long-term, stable remote engagements.



We're not a churn-and-burn agency. The people we place tend to stay with their clients for years, and we look after them properly throughout — from onboarding to ongoing support.



What We Offer



Permanent work-from-home arrangement

Long-term engagement with a stable Australian client

Competitive base salary — reviewed annually

Incentives tied to retention and account growth

Leave entitlements

Equipment and internet allowance where applicable

Direct support from a dedicated Australian-based operations team

Genuine career progression as our client base grows



How to Apply



Ready to be part of our team? Send us your resume and a short note about your experience.

Submit an ticket and our team will respond within one business day:

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant

Location: Remote

Schedule: Full-time with substantial overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours

Reports to: Company Leadership and the Operations Team

About the Role

We are hiring a proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to keep daily administrative and operational work organized, accurate, and moving forward. You will support company leadership and a distributed team by managing recurring tasks, coordinating schedules and follow-ups, maintaining records, preparing documents, and completing practical research and communication assignments.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating order, closing loops, and making a busy team easier to run. You will receive clear priorities, but you should be comfortable organizing the steps, asking focused questions, and completing routine work without repeated reminders.

What You Will Do

Manage inboxes, calendars, meetings, reminders, and recurring administrative tasks. Prepare agendas, meeting notes, follow-up lists, documents, and simple presentations. Maintain organized digital files, shared folders, templates, and internal records. Draft clear and professional communications.

Update project trackers, task boards, CRM records, spreadsheets, and databases. Coordinate appointments, deadlines, document requests, and project logistics. Follow up with team members, vendors, candidates, or customers and record next steps. Monitor assigned work and flag delays, missing information, or decisions requiring attention.

Conduct online research on vendors, tools, people, services, and business questions. Verify important details, compare options using practical criteria, and summarize findings clearly. Clean, organize, and quality-check information before it is shared or entered into a system.

Respond to routine questions by
 or chat using approved information and templates. Route requests to the correct owner and ensure promised follow-ups happen. Help onboard contractors or team members by preparing documents, access checklists, and schedules. Turn repeatable work into checklists, templates, and procedures.

What We Are Looking For

You have at least two years of experience as a Virtual Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Operations Assistant, Project Coordinator, or similar support professional. You communicate clearly in written and spoken English and demonstrate strong organization, accuracy, time management, and follow-through.

You are confident using Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, especially
, calendars, documents, and spreadsheets. You have experience updating a CRM, project-management system, tracker, or database and can manage multiple recurring tasks and deadlines remotely.

You exercise sound judgment with confidential information and professional communications. You have a reliable computer, stable internet, a backup plan, and a professional remote workspace. You can consistently overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours.

How You Work

You are dependable and careful. You meet commitments, communicate early when circumstances change, and check names, dates, links, numbers, attachments, and formatting before sending work.

You are resourceful and follow through. You search existing information, try reasonable solutions, ask specific questions, track responses, provide reminders when appropriate, and close the loop.

You communicate clearly and improve recurring work. Your updates explain what is complete, what is pending, and what needs a decision. When a task repeats, you help make it easier and more consistent.

Technology

You should be comfortable with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, video meetings, chat tools, shared drives, project-management software, and CRM systems. Familiarity with Notion, Airtable, Asana, ClickUp, 
, Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier, Make, or similar tools is helpful. Strong digital judgment and the ability to learn independently matter most.

What Success Looks Like

Calendars, inboxes, trackers, files, and recurring tasks stay organized and current. Routine requests are handled accurately. Team members receive timely follow-ups and understand the next step. Research and administrative deliverables are polished and ready to use. Important details and deadlines do not fall through the cracks. Repetitive work becomes documented and more efficient.

This Role Is Not a Fit If

This position is not a fit if you need step-by-step direction for every routine assignment, frequently miss details, wait silently when work is blocked, or are uncomfortable following up and learning new software. It is also not a fit if you prefer little written communication or personal accountability.

Working Arrangement

This is a full-time remote role for an independent professional. Substantial overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours is required. Compensation will be based on experience, demonstrated ability, and geographic market.

title: Senior Operations Assistant | Path to Operations Manager
description:
We are a growing UK wedding photography and videography company looking for an experienced Senior Operations Assistant to join the team.



This is not a traditional VA position focused on completing simple repetitive tasks.



We are looking for someone experienced, highly organised and capable who can work closely with the founder, learn how the business operates and gradually take ownership of a significant part of the company's day-to-day operations.



For the right person, the intention is for this position to develop into an Operations Manager role as the company continues to grow.



The Role



We work with a growing team of photographers, videographers, editors and other remote team members to deliver weddings across the UK.



The Senior Operations Assistant will initially work closely with the Director/CEO to understand how the company operates and gradually take responsibility for areas that are currently managed by him.



Responsibilities will include:



Managing the company's project management system and keeping projects up to date

Monitoring upcoming weddings and ensuring everything is prepared

Coordinating photographers, videographers, editors and other team members

Preparing team briefings, timelines and wedding information

Tracking photo and video editing deadlines

Following up with team members and editors

Monitoring projects from wedding day through editing, quality control and final delivery

Preparing and sending routine client communications

Checking questionnaires, timelines and other required information

Managing administrative tasks around invoices and outstanding balances

Organising digital files and cloud storage

Maintaining internal systems and processes

Creating and improving SOPs

Identifying opportunities to automate or simplify repetitive work

Helping solve operational problems before they need to be escalated

Eventually helping oversee operations during busy wedding weekends



The goal is not simply to complete assigned tasks.



The goal is to become someone who understands the business well enough to take ownership of outcomes.



Who we are looking For



This position is best suited to someone who already has significant professional experience.



Experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Operations Coordinator, Project Manager, Operations Manager or similar would be particularly valuable.



The ideal candidate will be:



Extremely organised and dependable

Experienced working independently

Excellent at written and spoken English

Confident communicating with UK-based clients and professionals

Calm when dealing with multiple priorities

Highly detail-oriented

Comfortable making sensible decisions without constant supervision

Proactive and able to identify problems before they become urgent

Technically confident and comfortable learning new software

Good at documenting and improving processes

Comfortable coordinating multiple people and deadlines

Interested in understanding how an entire business operates

Looking for a stable, long-term position



Previous wedding industry experience is not required.



Strong operational ability is much more important.



Systems & Technology



We use a range of systems including:





Google Workspace

Gmail

Google Calendar

Pic-Time



pCloud

Zapier





Previous experience with these specific platforms is helpful but not essential.



The successful candidate should, however, be very comfortable learning new technology.



Working Hours



This is intended to become a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.



We are based in the UK, so good availability during UK working hours is required.



Because weddings frequently take place at weekends, some weekend availability may occasionally be required as the candidate takes on greater operational responsibility.



Salary & Progression



Starting rate: $8 USD per hour



The starting rate reflects the initial training and shadowing period.



This is intended to be a long-term position with the opportunity for increased compensation as the successful candidate takes ownership of more areas of the business.



The long-term goal is for an exceptional candidate to progress from Senior Operations Assistant ? Operations Manager, with increased responsibility and compensation to reflect that progression.



Love On Film is looking for someone who wants to grow with the company rather than someone looking for a short-term VA position.



How to Apply



Please begin the application with:



LOVE ON FILM



Applications should include:



1. Introduction



A short introduction covering professional background, current role/situation and the type of position being sought.



2. Relevant Experience



Details of previous experience in areas such as operations, executive assistance, project management, customer service, events, team coordination or managing remote workers.



Please include examples of the level of responsibility held in previous positions.



3. Audio Introduction



Please record a 1–2 minute audio introduction using Vocaroo or a similar service.



The recording should introduce the applicant and explain why their experience and personality would make them a strong fit for this position.



Please include the link to the recording in the application.



Applications without an audio recording will not be considered.



The strongest applicants will be invited to a video interview where the role, previous experience and several real-world operational scenarios will be discussed in more detail.

title: Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Note: Interested applicants must submit their initial application exclusively through the OnlineJobs platform. Do not
 the company directly. Any candidate who contacts the company outside of the OnlineJobs system will be disqualified from consideration.



Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant



$6–$8 USD/hour | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Every day, dozens of cleaning appointments depend on someone noticing small scheduling problems before they become big ones.



We are looking for that person.



Maid In America Cleaning Services is hiring a highly organized Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant to coordinate mobile cleaning teams, maintain accurate operational data, and communicate with customers when schedules change.



This is not a general administrative assistant role. You must have previous experience scheduling or dispatching employees who travel to customer locations.



What You’ll Do



Your primary responsibility will be helping keep our field operations organized and running on schedule.



You will:

-Prepare and adjust cleaning schedules in Jobber

-Coordinate changes caused by call-outs, delays, and customer rescheduling requests

-Identify overlaps, drive-time issues, staffing conflicts, and other schedule problems

-Reassign or resequence jobs within established guidelines

-Answer inbound customer calls related to scheduling and basic support

-Make outbound calls to communicate delays and schedule changes

-Maintain accurate customer, job, and service information

-Update operational trackers and reports

-Complete invoicing, payroll-support, and cost-of-service tasks

-Escalate decisions that require management approval



You will follow established processes while also using judgment when a situation does not perfectly match the written procedure.



Who We’re Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Notice small details and inconsistencies others miss

-Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

-Enjoy solving scheduling and logistics problems

-Follow SOPs, checklists, and operating rules consistently

-Can investigate and solve routine problems independently

-Know when to stop and escalate a decision

-Communicate confidently and professionally with customers

-Stay calm when priorities change

-Learn new software quickly

-Take ownership of mistakes and correct them promptly



Required Experience



You must have previous experience scheduling or dispatching mobile field teams.



Relevant industries may include:

-Residential cleaning

-HVAC

-Plumbing

-Electrical

-Landscaping

-Pest control

-Home health

-Delivery

-Property maintenance

-Other field-service businesses



General calendar management, appointment setting, or meeting scheduling alone does not meet this requirement.



Strongly Preferred

-Direct Jobber experience

-Experience with other field-service platforms

-Customer phone support experience

-Dispatch or logistics experience

-Google Workspace

-Slack

-Spreadsheet and reporting experience



Work Requirements

-Full-time availability

-Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time

-Fluent spoken and written English

-Reliable computer and dedicated workspace

-Reliable internet connection with a backup option

-Backup power solution

-No work for another employer or client during scheduled working hours



Compensation



$6–$8 USD per hour, based on directly relevant experience.



Candidates with direct Jobber experience, mobile-team scheduling experience, and strong customer phone skills will receive priority consideration.



Our Core Values

-Communication

-Connection

-Quality

-Service

-Teamwork



How to Apply



Complete our Culture Index survey:


 



Begin your application subject line with the company core value you identify with most, written in ALL CAPS.



In your application message, include:

-The type of mobile field team you previously scheduled or dispatched

-Approximately how many employees and appointments you coordinated

-The scheduling or field-service software you used

-Whether you have direct Jobber experience

-One example of a scheduling problem you caught before it affected customers or employees



Applications that do not complete the Culture Index survey, follow the subject-line instruction, or demonstrate relevant field-team scheduling experience will not be reviewed.

Do not use AI to create generic responses or invent experiences. We may ask you to explain your answers during a live interview. At the end of your response, disclose whether you used AI and how.

title: CATEGORY RESEARCH & PRODUCT OPPORTUNITY ANALYST
description:
WDM Brands B.V. | Remote | 2 days per week (16 hours) | Freelance | USD $6-10/hr



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



You want to churn out long lists of keywords. This is deep work on one market at a time, not volume.

You struggle to say no. Half this job is telling us which opportunities to walk away from.

You have never sold or researched physical products online.

You cannot work with some overlap in European business hours.



If none of those apply, keep reading.



WHO WE ARE



WDM Brands is a Dutch e-commerce business selling around 500 products on 
, the largest marketplace in the Netherlands and Belgium. We are moving toward fewer, better products in bigger categories. To do that well, we need someone who can look at a whole market, tell us where the real opportunities are, and just as importantly, tell us where the traps are.



WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO



Each month you take one category and go deep. Not a list of keywords. A full read of the market. You come back with a clear presentation that answers three things:



Where are the real opportunities in this category, and why.

What should we avoid, and why. Too competitive, margins too thin, quality problems, whatever it is.

If you were us, what product line would you launch here, and what does the business case look like.



A concrete example. Say we give you fitness. A weak researcher comes back with "resistance bands have high demand." A strong one comes back with: skip resistance bands, the market is saturated and margins are gone, but adjustable dumbbells are a real opportunity, here are the three competitors worth studying, here is the price gap, here is the product line I would build and why. That second answer is the job.



WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE



You see a category as a set of segments, not a pile of products. You know which segments to go deep on and which to drop fast.

You are honest about what the data does and does not show. If demand looks strong but the proof is thin, you say so.

You think about margin, competition, and quality together, not just search volume.

You can turn a full category read into a clear, decision-ready presentation, not a raw spreadsheet.

You have the judgement to recommend a product line and stand behind it.



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



Real experience researching or selling physical products online. Amazon, Bol, Shopify, or similar.

Strong analytical skills. You are comfortable with competitor analysis, pricing, and margin thinking.

The ability to build a clear presentation that leads to a decision.

Fluent English, written and spoken.

Available 2 days per week (16 hours) with some overlap with European hours.



NICE TO HAVE



Experience with category management or private label product development.

Familiarity with tools like Helium 10, Keepa, or MarktMentor (we can provide access).

Experience presenting recommendations directly to a founder or decision-maker.



WHAT YOU GET OUT OF IT



Real ownership. Your research directly d
 what we launch. You see your calls play out in the business.

A direct line to the founder. No layers, no politics.

Room to grow. Starts at one category a month. If it works, it grows into more categories and more responsibility.

Performance bonus and a monthly health bonus you can put toward whatever keeps you well.

A flexible, remote team from all over the world.



HOW TO APPLY



No long CV. Answer these three questions in your own words. Keep it sharp.



Pick any product category you know well. Tell us one segment inside it you would avoid and one you would go after, and explain why for each. We care more about your reasoning than the specific products.

When you recommend launching a product, what do you need to see in the data before you are confident enough to put your name on it?

What is your experience with physical products online, and how many hours per week are you available?



One last thing. We get a lot of applications and most people do not read the full post. To show us you have, start your application with the word CATEGORY in capitals at the top. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



We look forward to hearing from someone who enjoys going deep.

title: Freelance Video Editor: Social Content
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read below before submitting your application.

In the application form, you’ll be required to share links so we can review your work. Please prepare and include:

- Examples of long form and short form content you have edited, and sample shorts/social media posts you’ve created (especially for Meta, Youtube, Instagram, and TikTok)

- Make sure all links are set to “viewable” and not private, so our team can properly review your work.



We're looking for a freelance Video Editor to turn raw footage into scroll-stopping social content for our own Social Pages. We shoot and send the raw footage, you cut it into strong options, and our team picks the best to run.



This is an ongoing freelance role, not a one-off gig. If you're fast, have a real eye for what performs on social, and want consistent work editing for a growing e-commerce agency, this is for you.

— Andy Gray, Founder & CEO 



WHO WE ARE

The Graygency is a performance marketing agency working with 7–8 figure DTC e-commerce brands across the UK, US, and Europe. We call ourselves Performance Scientists; we're in the P&L, not just the ad account. We're building an agency powered by systems, AI, and commercial thinking, not headcount.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Video Editing & Content Creation

- Turn raw footage we send you into polished, high-performing edits for YouTube, Shorts, TikTok, Reels, and Instagram

- Watch through raw footage and pull out the strongest hooks, moments, and soundbites

- Cut multiple edit options per piece of footage so our team can pick the strongest version to run

- Optimize videos for retention, engagement, and platform behavior



Motion Graphics & Creative Enhancement 

- Add dynamic motion graphics, text overlays, and visual effects

- Create scroll-stopping thumbnails and visual hooks

- Follow brief and brand guidelines from our Creative Strategists on angle, hook, and pacing



Performance-Driven Editing 

- Understand what makes content convert; not just look good

- Optimize cuts, pacing, and structure based on performance insights



Collaboration

- Work closely with Creative Strategists and Media Buyers

- Contribute ideas to improve creative performance

- Align editing decisions with campaign goals and strategy



Ad Hoc Creative Work 

- Support video ads, testimonials, and brand content

- Jump into fast-turnaround projects when needed



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Edits are consistently strong enough that our team is choosing between good options, not settling

- Fast, reliable turnaround on every batch of footage

- Edits reflect an understanding of what stops the scroll and holds retention, not just clean cuts



THE SKILLS WE NEED YOU TO BRING

- 2–5 years of experience editing video, ideally social-first content (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Reels)

- A strong portfolio of social edits, ideally with performance context (views, retention, etc.)

- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) and/or CapCut; After Effects a plus

- A genuine sense for pacing, hooks, and retention, not just technical editing

- Excellent written and verbal English communication

- Reliable internet connection and the ability to work to deadlines in a remote setup



NICE TO HAVES

- Experience editing for DTC or e-commerce brands

- Experience with AI video tools (Runway, Pika, Sora, Higgsfield)

- You run your own YouTube/TikTok, or have created UGC-style content yourself

- Basic motion graphics or 3D skills

- Familiarity with ClickUp or similar project management tools



WHAT WE OFFER

- Ongoing freelance work, not a one-off project, ideal for someone building a stable freelance client base

- Clear briefs and a real team around you: Creative Strategists and Media Buyers who give direction and feedback

- Fully remote, flexible hours



RED FLAGS (Don't Apply If…)

- You focus only on aesthetics and ignore performance

- You’ve never created content for social platforms

- You don’t understand retention, hooks, or pacing

- You wait for instructions instead of thinking creatively

- You struggle with feedback or iteration

- You can’t keep up with fast production cycles



OUR CULTURE

We believe in doing things well at The Graygency; we are constantly looking for ways to innovate and improve the delivery of our product. Every day we turn up and deliver our best work as a team in order to deliver the best results for the brands that trust us with their marketing budgets.



If you are ready to work and have the skills required, please submit your application directly here:

title: Engineer / Land Surveyor
description:
About Us

kdmHomes is committed to excellence in homebuilding across Ireland, delivering quality, integrity, and value in every project. Since 2005, kdmHomes has been shaping the future of building and civil engineering across Ireland and the UK.



Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Engineer / Land Surveyor to support our residential housing and civil engineering projects across Ireland.



The successful candidate will be responsible for processing land and point elevation survey data, creating contour surveys, preparing GPS machine-control files for excavators, and producing setting-out and as-built files for residential developments, roads, services, and foundations.

This role will work closely with architects, engineers, site teams, and project management to ensure accurate survey information is prepared and available for construction and project submission requirements.

The position may be offered on a full-time or part-time basis, depending on the candidate’s experience, availability, and project requirements.



Key Responsibilities



Survey Data & Contour Surveys

• Receive and review point elevation survey data from site.

• Create accurate contour surveys from received survey information.

• Process survey data for use in residential construction and civil engineering projects.

• Review survey information for accuracy and identify any discrepancies or missing information.

• Prepare files and drawings in the required formats for use by site and construction teams.



GPS Machine-Control Files

• Create GPS files for excavators and other site machinery.

• Prepare machine-control files showing required excavation levels and elevations.

• Generate files for foundations, roads, services, and other earthworks.

• Ensure GPS files accurately reflect the approved design and required construction levels.

• Coordinate with site teams to clarify requirements and make adjustments where necessary.



Setting-Out & Site Plans

• Review architects’ site plans and coordinate information.

• Use site coordinates to prepare setting-out files.

• Create files showing the locations of house corners and building positions.

• Prepare setting-out information for boundary fence lines, footpaths, roads, and other site features.

• Ensure coordinates and setting-out information are accurate and suitable for site use.



As-Built Surveys & Irish Water Submissions

• Receive and review as-built surveys from site.

• Process as-built survey information against approved designs and site requirements.

• Create accurate as-built files for completed works.

• Prepare files and documentation required for submission to Irish Water.

• Identify discrepancies between design information and completed works and raise these with the relevant team members.



General Project Support

• Maintain organised digital survey files and project records.

• Work closely with architects, engineers, site managers, and project teams.

• Provide technical support and survey-related information as required.

• Ensure survey files are clearly named, organised, and maintained for future reference.

• Work independently and meet project deadlines in a remote working environment.



Requirements



Essential

• Relevant experience as an Engineer, Land Surveyor, Civil Engineer, or similar role.

• Experience working with point elevation survey data.

• Experience creating contour surveys.

• Experience preparing GPS/machine-control files for excavators.

• Strong understanding of construction levels, coordinates, and setting-out.

• Experience interpreting architects’ site plans and coordinate information.

• Experience preparing setting-out files for residential developments.

• Experience with as-built surveys and documentation.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Strong communication and coordination skills.



Desirable

• Experience with roads, drainage, foundations, and site services.

• Experience working with construction GPS/machine-control systems.

• Proficiency with relevant surveying, CAD, or civil engineering software.



What We Offer

• Remote; Full-time

• Starting salary at $4 per hour, depending on your experience

• Mid-shift Schedule

• We offer a supportive, collaborative, and growing work environment

• Opportunity to work on residential construction and civil engineering projects across Ireland.

title: Video Editor for YouTube Long Form + Instagram Reels
description:
I run a sales education brand. I teach experienced sales reps how to get better results and get placed in high paying roles. I am looking for one editor to own my entire content output long term.



This is not a one off gig. I want someone who stays with me, learns my style, and gets faster and better every month.



What you will edit



2 long form YouTube videos per week. These are 30 minutes to 1 hour of raw footage, mostly talking head and training style content.

2 short form videos per day, 7 days a week (Instagram Reels, reused as YouTube Shorts and TikTok)



Where the short form comes from



You will be working from three types of source material:



Long form recordings and call recordings I send you. You watch these and pull the strongest moments, then cut them into shorts.

Reels I film myself on my phone, which you clean up and edit.

Clips from the YouTube long form videos you already edited.



Part of the job is finding the content, not just cutting it. If I send you a 45 minute recording, I expect you to come back with the moments worth posting.



You will not be guessing



I send editing briefs. You will know what I am looking for in each video, which sections matter, what the hook should be and what the point of the piece is. You bring the eye and the execution, I give you the direction.



Editing style



Long form: Alex Hormozi style. No background music at all, not even subtle. This rule is not flexible. Tight cuts to remove dead air and filler, burned in captions, selective punch ins, simple text callouts and basic graphics when a point needs emphasis. No heavy motion graphics, no cinematic transitions, no stock footage overload. The talking is the content. Nothing should compete with it.



Short form: clean and simple. Strong first frame, captions that are easy to read on mobile, tight pacing, cuts that keep retention. Vertical 9:16, safe zones respected so nothing gets covered by the UI.



What I actually need from you



I am not looking for someone who only follows instructions. I want an editor who understands the platforms.



You should know:



What makes someone stop scrolling in the first 2 seconds

Why some Reels get pushed and others die

How retention works differently on YouTube long form vs Shorts

How to cut a video so the message lands, not just so it looks nice



Requirements



Strong English. You must understand my content well enough to know which lines matter and which moments are worth clipping. This is non negotiable.

Comfortable working with long recordings. You will regularly be handed 30 to 60 minutes of raw footage and expected to cut it down cleanly.

Proven experience editing talking head content for YouTube and short form for Instagram or TikTok

Portfolio with real examples, ideally in the business, coaching, sales or personal brand space

Ability to handle daily volume without quality dropping

Reliable turnaround. Long form within 48 hours, shorts within 24 hours.

Available for daily communication on Slack or WhatsApp

Your own computer and editing software (Premiere Pro, CapCut, After Effects or similar)

Stable internet and enough storage to handle large files



Nice to have



Experience with thumbnails

Basic audio cleanup

Experience posting or scheduling content



Why this role is worth taking seriously



I am not looking to fill a seat for three months. I am building a team.



I want one editor who grows with the brand. As my output and revenue grow, your pay grows with it. First review at 90 days.

I am well connected in the info and coaching space. Editors who do good work for me get seen and get referred. That has real value for your career and your rates.

Long term, I want the person in this seat travelling with me and filming on location, not just editing from a folder. If that is something you want, say so in your application.



What you get



$500 USD per month to start, paid on time, every month

Long term stable work with one client

Performance review at 90 days with a clear path to increase

Clear editing briefs, organised file delivery, no chaos



HIRING PROCESS



You apply following the instructions below

Short call so we can talk through your experience

Paid trial. Shortlisted candidates get the same raw recording and a brief, and produce 1 long form edit and 2 shorts pulled from it. I pay $30 USD for the trial whether or not I hire you.

Offer and start date



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic application. I read every one and I ignore copy paste messages.



Start your message with the word RETENTION so I know you read this fully.

Send me 2 or 3 links to work you personally edited. Tell me exactly what you did on each one.

Answer this in 3 sentences or less: what is the number one reason most talking head Reels fail in the first 3 seconds?

Tell me what software you use and your current time zone.

Confirm you can handle 2 shorts per day, 7 days a week.



Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: Prompt Engineer
description:
Prompt Engineer



Location: Remote Type: Full-time



About the Role



Pronexis is looking for a Prompt Engineer to design, test, and refine the AI-driven conversational and automation experiences powering our franchise technology platform. You'll work closely with our Solutions and AI Ops teams to build prompts and integrations that connect intelligently with our existing LAMP/Laravel stack, our React-based frontends, and our voice/telephony and call center systems.



This is a hands-on technical role — you won't just be writing prompts in isolation, you'll be integrating them into real product workflows, testing them against live systems, and iterating based on production data.



What You'll Do

Design, test, and optimize prompts for AI-driven workflows (chat, voice, automation, agent tooling)

Design and refine AI-driven call workflows — call flows, routing logic, IVR, and how prompts behave at each step of a live call

Integrate prompt logic with backend services built on PHP/Laravel and front-end interfaces built in React

Collaborate on voice AI integrations, including call flows, transcription, and real-time response handling (Twilio or similar platforms)

Evaluate and refine outputs from LLM-based systems for accuracy, tone, and reliability

Build and maintain prompt libraries, evaluation frameworks, and versioning practices

Work with the team to troubleshoot edge cases, hallucinations, and failure modes in live workflows

Document prompt architecture and decision rationale for other engineers and PMs

Must-Haves

Solid experience with the LAMP stack (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP)

Hands-on experience with Laravel

Working knowledge of React

Familiarity with Twilio or another voice/telephony integration platform (IVR, call routing, real-time transcription, etc.)

Familiarity with designing or configuring call workflows — call flows, routing, IVR logic, or agent call handling

Understanding of CRM and call center systems and how AI/automation fits into lead and contact workflows

Demonstrated experience writing, testing, and iterating on prompts for production LLM use cases (not just casual chatbot experimentation)

Strong understanding of how prompt design interacts with system architecture — not just "what to write" but "how it fits"

Nice-to-Haves

Experience with the Connex AI platform

Experience with CRM/franchise or field-service platforms (ServiceMinder, Jobber, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro)

Hands-on experience building call center or contact center automation (agent assist, call routing, post-call workflows)

Familiarity with agentic workflows, tool-calling, or multi-step LLM orchestration

Background in evaluation/testing frameworks for LLM output quality

What Success Looks Like



Within your first few months, you're independently designing and shipping prompt-driven features that integrate cleanly with our Laravel backend and React frontends, contributing to voice AI and call workflows, and helping the team build repeatable practices around prompt testing and quality.

title: SDR / APPOINTMENT SETTER
description:
Role: Sales Development Representative / Setter  

Company: Maison Noir  

Location: Remote (UK hours)  



Mission



Your mission is simple: turn cold and warm prospects into qualified, showing sales appointments for our closers. You own response, schedule, and show. 



What You’ll Own 



• Hit daily outbound activity targets across DM, phone, and socials.

• Respond fast to new leads and pull appointments forward whenever possible (same-day or “right now” when they’re free). 

• Qualify prospects using our checklist so only best-fit leads reach our closers.  

• Confirm and re-confirm appointments, using scripts to reduce no-shows and reschedules. 

• Keep the CRM clean: every touch logged, every lead in the right stage.  

• BAMFAM every time: book a meeting from a meeting so no lead drifts into “no man’s land.” 



Key Outcomes (How You’re Measured)



• Booked qualified meetings per month (primary KPI).  

• Held meeting rate (show rate) on the meetings you book.  

• Daily activity volume (multi-channel touches) while following the process. 

• Pipeline quality: % of meetings that match our ICP and pass sales quality checks. 



We reward both quantity and quality: you get paid more when your meetings show and convert, not just when you spam the calendar. 



Day-to-Day Responsibilities



• Make high-volume, high-quality outbound touches to our target accounts daily.  

• Use our scripts to start conversations, ask qualifying questions, and transition to a booked call with a closer. 

• Double-dial, text, and follow structured cadence on day 1, day 2, and following days to maximize responses and shows. 

• Send short, natural messages (not walls of text) that keep conversations going and pull people toward booking. 

• Coordinate “hot handoffs” to closers and send confirmations/reminders so prospects know who they’re meeting and when. 

• Participate in daily roleplay and coaching to improve openers, questions, and objection handling.



What Success Looks Like in 90 Days



• You consistently hit or exceed your daily activity targets and monthly meeting quota.  

• Your show rate and meeting quality are at or above team average.   

• Closers request your leads because they know they’re prepped and serious.  

• You know the scripts cold and need minimal oversight.



Requirements



• 1+ year in an outbound SDR / setter / cold outreach role (agency, B2B services, SaaS, or similar).  

• Comfortable with high-volume repetitive work and being measured on numbers. 

• Strong written and spoken communication in English.  

• Experience with a CRM and basic sales tools.

title: UGC Manager
description:
# UGC Manager — E-commerce & TikTok Shop



**Location:** [Remote} 

**Employment type:** [Full
]  

**Reports to:** [Head of Marketing/Creative Director]



## About the Role



We are looking for an organized, relationship-driven UGC Manager to lead our creator partnerships and user-generated content program. The ideal candidate has managed UGC creators in an agency or e-commerce environment and understands how to produce high-performing, conversion-focused content at scale.



You will oversee the complete creator workflow—from sourcing and outreach to briefing, negotiation, content delivery, and performance analysis. You will also play a key role in our TikTok Shop strategy, including affiliate creator recruitment, content coordination, product seeding, and campaign optimization.



## Key Responsibilities



- Develop and manage relationships with UGC creators, influencers, and TikTok Shop affiliates.

- Source, evaluate, recruit, and onboard creators who align with our brand, products, and target customers.

- Manage creator outreach, negotiations, contracts, product seeding, payments, timelines, and deliverables.

- Create clear, compelling briefs that communicate hooks, angles, scripts, calls to action, and brand guidelines.

- Maintain an organized content pipeline and ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.

- Review creator submissions and provide clear, constructive feedback and revision requests.

- Collaborate with paid media, creative, social, and e-commerce teams to identify content needs and winning concepts.

- Manage TikTok Shop creator and affiliate relationships, including outreach, sample requests, commission opportunities, and campaign participation.

- Monitor creator and content performance using metrics such as views, engagement, click-through rate, conversion rate, revenue, ROAS, and GMV.

- Identify winning creators, formats, hooks, and messaging, then use those insights to improve future campaigns.

- Maintain a searchable library of creator content, usage rights, agreements, and performance data.

- Stay current on UGC trends, TikTok Shop features, platform policies, creator strategies, and social-commerce best practices.



## Required Experience and Skills



- [2–4]+ years of experience managing UGC, influencer, or creator partnerships in an agency or e-commerce environment.

- Hands-on experience working with TikTok Shop, including its affiliate or creator ecosystem.

- Demonstrated experience managing multiple creator relationships and content projects simultaneously.

- Strong understanding of direct-response creative and content designed to drive e-commerce sales.

- Experience sourcing creators, conducting outreach, negotiating rates, and managing contracts and usage rights.

- Ability to write effective creator briefs, hooks, scripts, and content concepts.

- Strong project-management skills with close attention to deadlines and details.

- Confident communicator who can build positive, long-term creator relationships while maintaining accountability.

- Comfortable analyzing content and sales performance to make data-informed decisions.

- Familiarity with tools such as TikTok Shop Seller Center, creator-management platforms, project-management software, spreadsheets, and shared content libraries.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience managing TikTok Shop affiliate programs or performance-based creator campaigns.

- Experience with product seeding, gifting programs, and high-volume creator outreach.

- Familiarity with paid social advertising on TikTok and Meta.

- Experience working with consumer products in [beauty, wellness, fashion, food, fitness, or relevant category].

- Existing relationships with UGC creators, TikTok affiliates, or creator agencies.

- Experience scaling a creator program across multiple products, brands, or client accounts.



## What Success Looks Like



- A reliable pipeline of qualified creators and TikTok Shop affiliates.

- Consistent delivery of high-quality, on-brand content.

- Faster creator turnaround times and fewer missed deadlines.

- Strong creator retention and productive long-term partnerships.

- Measurable improvements in content performance, TikTok Shop GMV, conversions, and return on creator investment.

- A well-organized system for tracking creators, deliverables, costs, usage rights, and results.



## How to Apply



Please submit your résumé along with examples of UGC or TikTok Shop campaigns you have managed. Where possible, include measurable results, the number of creators managed, your responsibilities, and examples of content or creator programs you helped scale.

title: Project Manager — Real Estate Media (QC, Delivery & Client Communication)
description:
We're a real estate photography company in Canada. We shoot listings, our editors produce the photos, floor plans, videos and virtual tours, and we deliver them to real estate agents. You'd be the person who makes sure that whole process actually finishes properly, every day.



What you'll do



- Quality control. Check finished work before it goes out — photos, floor plans, videos, virtual tours. You're the last set of eyes.

- Deliver to clients. Send the finished job to the agent and make sure they have what they paid for.

- Talk to clients. Answer questions, follow up, keep them updated when something changes.

- Answer the phone. Inbound calls from agents — booking shoots, checking on orders, general questions.

- Handle SMS. Reply to customer texts.

- Keep the team moving. Chase our editors and photographers when something is late, missing, or unclear. Not managing them — just making sure nothing sits.



Two tools: our own platform (we'll train you — it's where jobs, media and delivery live) and GoHighLevel for calls and texts.



That's the whole job. No sales, no marketing, no editing, no admin work outside this.



The hours — read this part carefully



Our clients are in Alberta, Canada (Mountain Time). The phone has to be answered during their business day, which means your shift is roughly 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday.



This is a permanent night shift. If that doesn't work for your life, this role won't either — and that's completely fine. Please don't apply hoping it'll change.



What we need



- Strong spoken English. You'll be on the phone with Canadian clients daily.

- Clear written English for texts and
s.

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to take calls.

- Organized. You'll juggle a lot of jobs at once and nothing can quietly fall through.

- Comfortable telling a teammate their work needs redoing, politely.



What we don't need



- Real estate experience.

- Photography or editing skills.

- A degree.



We'll train you on everything specific to us. We care that you're dependable, easy to talk to, and that things don't get lost with you.



To apply

1. Your name and where you're based.

2. A voice recording (30–60 seconds) — just introduce yourself and tell us about a time you had to chase someone to get something finished. Any recording app is fine.

title: Full-Stack Developer (Front & Back end) - No graveyard shift
description:

We build web apps, customer-facing tools, internal systems, and conversational-AI agents — the back-and-forth AI assistants that handle chat, capture leads, book appointments, and answer customers — for service-industry businesses across Singapore (clinics, salons, F&B, fitness, real estate, education, and more). You'd work across a range of client projects, taking features from idea to shipped.



We're looking for a full-stack developer who's strong on both the front end and the back end and can own work end to end, not just wait for tickets.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Build features across the stack — from the UI in the browser to the data and logic behind it.

- Front end: build clean, responsive interfaces in Next.js / React that match the design and feel good to use.

- Back end: model data, write APIs, and work with Supabase / PostgreSQL (auth, storage, database) to make it reliable.

- Build and wire up conversational-AI agents and chat automations — connecting them to our clients' tools, data, and workflows.

- Ship and iterate on Vercel, watch performance, and fix issues quickly.

- Integrate third-party tools and APIs — payments, messaging, CRMs, automation platforms.

- Work directly with us and, at times, with clients — so clear communication matters.





TECH WE WORK WITH



Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase / PostgreSQL, Vercel, REST APIs, and common integrations. On the conversational-AI side: GoHighLevel, 
, Assistable AI, n8n, and similar. You don't need every one, but you should be strong across the modern JavaScript / TypeScript stack and quick to pick up new tools.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Strong full-stack skills — you can build a feature front to back without it handed to you in pieces.

- Real fluency with Next.js / React and a Postgres-backed backend (Supabase a big plus).

- A solid grasp of APIs, authentication, and data modelling.

- Obsessed with Claude. We're a Claude shop — Claude Code especially — and we want someone who reaches for it constantly, pushes what it can do, and uses AI to genuinely build: write, refactor, debug, and ship real code. A capable equivalent like ChatGPT is fine, but the bar is using it professionally to produce, not just chatting with it. We're not screening out people who mostly chat today, but the people who thrive here are the ones a little obsessed with getting more out of these tools.

- Self-directed and reliable — this is remote contract work, so you run your own process, communicate clearly, and hit milestones without hand-holding.

- Good written English.

- Prefer availability 9am – 6pm Philippine time.





NICE TO HAVE



- Hands-on with conversational-AI / AI-agent platforms — GoHighLevel, 
, Assistable AI, or similar — and comfortable wiring up chat flows and automations.

- Experience with agency or client work — juggling more than one project at a time.

- Payments, booking flows, or marketplace experience.

- Familiarity with automation tools like n8n or Make, or messaging APIs (WhatsApp).

- Some DevOps comfort — CI, environments, monitoring.





THE ENGAGEMENT



- Type: Freelance / independent contract, project-based, full time

- Location: Fully remote. We work on Singapore time (UTC+8), so if you're in the Philippines your day lines up with ours — same hours, no graveyard shifts.

- Pay: In PHP, paid reliably on agreed milestones via Wise. No chasing, no surprises.

- Rate: Competitive and open — tell us your rate (hourly or per-milestone) and how you'd like to structure it.

- Start: Soon. We're ready to move once we find the right person.





WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU



- Normal working hours in your own timezone — no graveyard shifts.

- Variety — real projects for real businesses, not ticket-work.

- Ownership, and room to grow with us if it's a good fit.

- A small, respectful, English-speaking team that won't micro-manage you.





HOW TO APPLY



Send us a few things — keep it short:

- A link to your GitHub, portfolio, or something you've built (required — we care more about the work than a CV).

- A couple of lines on a project you built end to end, and how you used AI in it.

No long cover letter needed.

title: Direct Response Video Editor (VSL) - Remote, Part-Time or Full-Time
description:
Most editors never find out if their work sold anything. You cut it, you send it, the client says "love it," and that's the last you ever hear. You've been paid to guess for years.



This job is the opposite.



We're Dogbiotics. We make a dental supplement for dogs that's backed by three peer-reviewed published studies, and we've sold it to more than 40,000 customers. We run real paid spend, every week, and we know exactly which creative is working and which isn't.



We're hiring video editors to cut the ads that carry that spend. You'll see the performance data on every single thing you make. When your cuts win, you get paid more. There's no ceiling on that.



What you'll actually be doing



You'll cut 2-5 minute VSLs and direct response video ads for a 55+ audience of dog owners who are scared of putting their senior dog under anesthesia for a $1,500 dental cleaning. Holding that person's attention for three straight minutes is genuinely hard. That's the job.



You'll also cut variants of your own winners. Most of the work in direct response isn't new ideas every week. It's finding the thing that works and then attacking it from nine angles until it stops working. If iteration bores you, this seat will make you miserable.



Most of what you make will get killed by the data, not by us. That's not a criticism of you. That's how the discipline works, and the editors who thrive here are the ones who find that freeing instead of crushing.



What we need from you



Real direct response experience. Not brand films. Not wedding videos. Ads that ran on paid traffic with a conversion goal.



Long-form. You've cut 2-5 minute VSLs before and you understand why the 40-second mark is where you lose everyone.



Genuine AI fluency. Not "I've used ChatGPT." We mean AI is load-bearing in your actual pipeline: script variants, voice, generative 



b-roll, captioning, assembly. We'll ask you specifically where it sits in your process and what it replaced.



Speed. Quality edits. quickly.



A portfolio. Details below, and please don't send a showreel.

We don't care about your degree. We don't care how many years you've been doing this. If your last three edits are your best three edits, we should talk.



How we work



You see the performance data on your own edits. Spend, hook rate, hold, CPA, and whether it scaled or got turned off. That is standard here, not a perk we hand out on request.



There is a standing weekly creative review where we go through what ran, what the numbers were, and what we are cutting next.



Hours are 100% flexible. Part-time and full-time are both real options, not a trial period before we push you into full-time.



Growth path is editor to senior editor to owning the video lane.



Pay is strong and tied to performance. We handle the specifics on the call.



To apply



One Google Form: 



It takes about 10 minutes. It asks for your portfolio and a few questions about how you work.



No showreels. No agencies.

description:
About us



Bua Health is a digital healthcare provider focused on weight loss in Ireland. We help people access clinically appropriate weight loss care, including GLP-1 medications, through a doctor-led telehealth platform. We're small, moving fast, and we care a lot about how our brand shows up in front of people.

 and social media. It needs to be world class content similar to 
/, 
, and similar operators (please check out their social media).



We want someone who can look at a blank page and think through what to say, who it's for, and why now, then write it, then design it into something that actually looks good in an inbox and in a social feed.



You'll build a long-term
 nurture programme for people who come through our funnel and qualify for our weight loss programme, and you'll create ongoing social media content that builds the Bua brand as a trusted, human, digital care service.



This is a long-term role, and we're looking for someone who can grow in their role with them team.



What you'll do



- Build the content strategy: what we say, to whom, and when, across
 sequences and social channels.

- Write the copy:
s, captions, hooks, subject lines, short-form scripts. Warm, clear, human, medically responsible.

- Design the finished output:
s and social posts that meet our brand standards. Canva preferred, but use whatever tool you're strongest in.

- Ensure
 sequences can be implemented in Mailchimp so they're built, tested, and ready to fire.



*What we need you to be great at*



We think of this role as two halves, and we need both.



The strategy half:

Segmenting audiences and mapping content journeys that make sense for where someone is in their decision. Choosing hooks, angles, and formats that suit the platform and the moment.



The execution half:

Visual design that feels engaging, helpful and sharp.

Experience producing short-form video content or scripts, not just static posts.

Familiarity with the GLP-1 / weight loss category.

We're AI-first and we expect you to be too. Use AI heavily in your workflow: drafting, ideation, image generation with Gemini, refinement. How to apply

2. For shortlisted candidates, we'll move to a task so you can show us what you can do

4. Hire

title: Social Media Manager (Instagram Growth)
description:
Social Media Manager (Instagram Growth) — Emma Hokayem Coaching



I'm hiring one person to own our social media and grow it. This is not an admin role and it's not a posting-and-scheduling role. I'm looking for someone who lives and breathes Instagram, knows what makes a reel travel, and has actually grown accounts before. If that's you, keep reading.



Who we are



Emma Hokayem Coaching is a women's fitness, nutrition and mindset coaching business based in Edinburgh. We help women change their lives through strength training, nutrition and mindset. Most of our clients find us on social media, so this channel is the heart of the business. That's exactly why I'm hiring someone brilliant to run it.



The mission



Grow our Instagram. Organically. Build a presence that makes women trust us before they've even spoken to us. I'll be filming plenty of content for you to work with. Your job is to turn it into scroll-stopping reels, get it in front of the right women, and turn attention into conversations and clients.



What you'll own



-Editing all our reels from the footage I film, into a highly engaging, native format

-Writing hooks and captions that stop the scroll and get people to act

-Planning and scheduling all content, and keeping the calendar full and consistent

-Thinking ahead. Spotting what's trending and flagging key dates (National Fitness Day is a good example) and telling me what we should be doing about them

-Setting up and managing our comment-to-DM automation (ManyChat), for example comment WAITLIST, receive the link

-Handling all our DMs, following up with new leads manually, and warming them toward a sales call with me

-Watching the numbers and telling me what's working and what isn't



Who I'm looking for



I want someone with a proven history of doing this well. Not basic. Not learning on my account. I want to see accounts you've grown and reels you've made, with real results behind them. PLEASE DON'T APPLY IF YOU DON'T HAVE THIS EXPERIENCE AS IT'S WASTING BOTH OF OUR TIME



You are:



-Genuinely skilled at short-form video editing and hooks

-Proactive. You bring me ideas, you don't wait to be told

-A strong writer with excellent spoken and written English

-Someone who takes full ownership and follows things through

-Organised, reliable, and able to manage your own time

-Someone who actually understands Instagram growth in 2026, not five years ago



Tools you must know



CapCut (or equivalent), Instagram, Canva, ManyChat, and Google Docs/Sheets/Drive. Experience with Go High Level is a bonus.



Hours and pay



25 hours a week to start, five days a week, working through UK daytime and into our early-evening posting and engagement window. There is real potential to move to full-time based on how you perform and the results you bring. This is a role I want to grow with the right person.



I'm not publishing a rate. In your application, tell me your expected hourly rate. I'm hiring on quality first.



How to apply



Send a short Loom video (under 3 minutes) to 



Put the words "I read everything" in the subject line.



In the video, tell me:



-Who you are

-What you've done that fits this role, with proof (share links to accounts you've grown and reels you've edited)

-Why you're the right person for this

-What you know about Emma Hokayem Coaching



And so I can see how you think, include two things in your
:



-One reel hook you'd write for a video aimed at a woman aged 42 who is nervous to start strength training

-Your expected hourly rate



Applications without the subject line, without proof of past work, and without those two things will not be considered. I read everything, so I need to know you did too.



Successful candidates will be contacted the week commencing 17th.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
We’re looking for an A+ Creative Strategist with strong DTC/eCommerce experience, not just general social media or content experience.



What This Role Actually Is



You will own the creative strategy behind our Meta ad campaigns. That means you are responsible for figuring out which angles to test, why they should work, what the hook should be, what the script structure should look like, what the visual direction should be, and what we should learn from each test, win or lose.

You will create the concepts. Video editors, graphic designers, and UGC creators will execute them based on your direction.



What You Will Do



Research competitors using
 Ads Library, Foreplay, Reddit, Amazon reviews, customer comments, and ecommerce trends then turn that research into testable ad concepts, not just notes.

Develop ad angles, hooks, scripts, and creative briefs for Meta ads across TOFU, MOFU, and BOFU. You should know the difference and write differently for each.

Analyze winning and losing ads to identify what specifically is working. The hook type, the pacing, the objection handling, the offer framing, the visual structure, not just "this ad did well."

Write scripts for video ads, UGC concepts, and image ads that sound human, feel premium, and are specific to the product. Generic AI-sounding copy will not survive here.

Create clear creative directions for editors and creators.

Build weekly and monthly creative testing plans based on product goals, performance data, and angle rotation.

Review creatives before they launch and give honest, specific feedback on hook strength, messaging, visual-voiceover alignment, compliance risk, and conversion potential.

Ensure every concept is compliant with Meta ad policies. No medical claims, no body-shaming, no cure/treat/fix language, no unrealistic promises.



Ideal qualifications:



Proven experience as a Creative Strategist for DTC/eCommerce brands

Strong copywriting skills, especially for paid ads, UGC scripts, hooks, and direct-response angles

Experience creating ad concepts, scripts, briefs, and creative testing ideas

Strong understanding of Meta/TikTok ad creatives, hooks, retention, pacing, and conversion angles

Has worked with brands that spend heavily on paid ads

Can show proof of ads or campaigns that scaled

Can analyze winning ads and explain why they worked

Can create new angles based on customer pain points, reviews, competitors, Reddit, comments, and market research

title: Loan Processor (DSCR / Non-QM) - AI-Powered Team, US Mortgage
description:
US mortgage broker (DSCR, non-QM, bridge, fix & flip) looking for a loan processor who is

genuinely good with AI tools. Read that part carefully, because it is the whole job.



We run Claude on every single loan file. It reads the inbox, tracks the conditions, drafts

the
s, and keeps the file organized. That means I am NOT hiring someone to retype

condition lists into a spreadsheet. I am hiring someone who can look at a conditional

approval, understand what the underwriter actually wants, figure out how to get it, and

then pick up the phone and go get it.



A processor with 3 years of experience who is sharp with AI will beat a processor with 10

years who is not. If you are the second kind, this is not your role.



We close files in 2 to 3 weeks. Not 5. That speed is our entire competitive advantage, and

it comes from being organized and aggressive on follow-up.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

- Own files end to end: initial docs through clear to close

- Read conditional approvals and clear conditions one by one

- Order and chase title, insurance, appraisals, payoffs, VOMs, HOA docs

 alone does not close files in 2 weeks.

- Keep our borrower portal and CRM current

- Escalate to me with a recommendation, not just a question



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- Claude, with our custom skills already built for loan processing,
 drafting,

  document review, e-signature, and research

- Our own borrower portal and CRM (you get your own login, can call and text from it)

- A company
 address

- Full SOPs and Loom walkthroughs of how we do everything

- Real autonomy. I do not monitor screens. I care that files close.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- Experience processing US mortgage files (DSCR, non-QM, hard money, or investor loans

  strongly preferred, but I care more about how you think than years on a resume)

- You actually use AI tools daily and can prove it

- You are not afraid of the phone. This is non-negotiable.

- Clear written and spoken English

- Available during US Eastern business hours

- Reliable internet and backup power



COMPENSATION

$600 to $1,500/month depending on experience, plus bonuses on files that close on time.

HOW TO APPLY - follow this exactly or I will not read it

Answer these three things in your message:

title: Book keeper
description:
Construction Admin & MYOB Job Costing VA



We are an Australian demolition, excavation and civil works company looking for a reliable, switched-on Virtual Assistant to help manage our MYOB administration, invoicing, job costing and general project administration.



This is intended to become an ongoing position for the right person.



Main Responsibilities



You will assist with:



* Creating and sending customer quotes in MYOB

* Creating progress claims and invoices

* Entering supplier invoices and expenses

* Allocating costs to the correct project/job

* Maintaining accurate job costing records

* Tracking labour, subcontractors, plant hire, truck hire, tipping fees and materials

* Comparing quoted costs against actual job costs

* Tracking variations and additional works

* Monitoring outstanding and overdue invoices

* Maintaining supplier and subcontractor records

* Organising receipts, invoices and project documentation

* Preparing simple weekly job profitability reports

* General construction administration



Job Costing



This is a very important part of the role.



For each project, we want to clearly see:



Original Contract / Quote Value

Approved Variations

Total Revenue

Labour Costs

Plant & Equipment Costs

Subcontractor Costs

Waste / Tipping Costs

Materials & Other Costs

Total Actual Cost

Gross Profit

Gross Margin %



You must be comfortable receiving information from us in a practical construction format and turning it into organised job-costing records.



For example:



Excavator – 3 days @ $960/day

Float – $350

Labour – 2 men × 8 hours @ $59/hour

Truck – $400/day

Dirt disposal – 25 tonnes @ $79/tonne

Dumper hire – $198/day



You should be able to correctly calculate, record and allocate these costs to the appropriate project.



Required Experience



Applicants should have:



* Strong MYOB experience

* Experience with invoicing, quotes and accounts payable/receivable

* Good Excel or Google Sheets skills

* Strong numerical ability and attention to detail

* Good written English

* Excellent organisation

* Ability to work independently

* Reliable internet connection



Experience working with an Australian construction, demolition, excavation, civil or trade business is highly desirable.



Previous construction job-costing experience will be strongly preferred.



What We’re Looking For



We want someone who takes ownership of their work.



If something doesn’t reconcile, we want you to investigate it rather than simply enter the numbers.



If a supplier invoice doesn’t identify which project it belongs to, flag it.



If actual costs on a project are approaching or exceeding the allowance, tell us.



If a customer invoice becomes overdue, flag it.



The goal is to give management an accurate picture of what every project is costing and whether it is making money.



Application Instructions



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of MYOB experience do you have?

2. Which MYOB products have you used?

3. Have you worked for an Australian construction or trade business before?

4. Describe how you have previously managed job costing.

5. What information would you include in a weekly job profitability report?

6. What is your expected hourly rate in PHP?

7. How many hours per week are you available?

8. What hours are you available in Sydney, Australia time?



Please start your application with the words:



“JOB COSTING”



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



Shortlisted Applicant Test



Shortlisted applicants will be given a small paid job-costing exercise before appointment.



The exercise will involve taking a sample construction project with labour, machinery, disposal and subcontractor costs and producing a simple job-cost report showing:



* Revenue

* Total costs

* Cost categories

* Gross profit

* Gross margin

* Any errors or missing information they identify



We are looking for accuracy, initiative and attention to detail — not just data entry.

title: Social Media and Email Management VA (You Must Use AI Daily)
description:
We run Meedu, an online education business. We are hiring a full time VA to run our social media and inboxes, and to help organise the people we work with.



This role is built around AI. We move fast because we automate everything we can, and we need someone who already works that way. Just as important: we need someone smart enough to know when not to trust it. AI drafts, you check. Anything that goes out under our name has been read, fact checked and made to sound human by you.



What you will do



1. Social media. Run our accounts day to day: plan, draft and publish posts, reply to comments and messages, keep a content calendar, and grow our following across platforms.



2.
 management. Keep our inboxes under control, draft replies for approval, and follow up so nothing gets dropped.



3. Outreach. Message pages, groups, influencers and organisations, track everything in a sheet, and book calls with the founder.



4. Organising people. Schedule our content reviewers and contributors, set up calendar links, send reminders, and chase deliverables.



5. Other tasks as they come up. The principle is always the same: if a tool can do it in a tenth of the time, you set that up first.



You are a great fit if you



- Use Claude, ChatGPT or similar every day for real work, not just writing captions

- Have worked with AI agents and understand how AI plugs into calendars,
 and other everyday tools to speed up basic tasks

- Have automated something that used to take hours: mail merges, report drafting, spreadsheet work, scheduling

- Never trust AI output blindly: you check facts, catch the errors, and rewrite anything that sounds robotic before it goes anywhere

- Can set up practical tools without hand holding: canned replies, simple automations, trackers

- Are at home in project management tools like Trello, Asana, Notion or ClickUp: you keep tasks, boards and deadlines up to date without being chased

- Write natural, professional English

- Log your work as you go, in a live tracker, not screenshots assembled afterwards



Details



- Fully remote, full time

- Paid role with a paid trial period; pay is discussed at interview and based on what you can actually deliver

- You report directly to the founder



How to apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph ONLY, using the apply button on this post. Do NOT
 us. Applications sent by
 will not be considered. We review every application through the platform so we can see your full profile.



In your application, include:



1. A short intro: who you are and what you do now

2. Your best example of a task you automated with AI: what it was, which tools you used, and how long it takes now versus before

3. An example of a time AI got something wrong and how you caught it



We review applications as they arrive.
