title: US Healthcare Content & Communications Specialist (USRN)
description:
Paid Freelance / Project-Based Engagement | Remote | Philippines Only



We are looking for a US Registered Nurse (USRN) who is also an excellent natural writer to work with us on healthcare content and communications.



We are looking for someone who understands the US healthcare environment, can research independently, identify relevant topics, and turn healthcare knowledge and real-world practice challenges into clear, engaging, and original content.



This engagement will begin on a project basis. Our intention is to identify the right writer for regular ongoing work and, as our content and client requirements grow, evaluate the opportunity for a full-time role.



About Our Work



We support US physicians and medical practices across multiple areas, including:



* Patient Access & Front-Office Support — scheduling, patient coordination and communication, referrals, orders, and administrative support

* Insurance & Authorization Support — eligibility and benefits verification, prior authorizations, and payer follow-ups

* Credentialing & Provider Enrolment

* Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) — billing and coding support, claims, accounts receivable, denials, and related functions

* Healthcare Documentation — AI-assisted documentation and scribing, medical scribing, medical transcription, and EHR documentation support

* Audit, Compliance & Documentation Review — documentation completeness and consistency, diagnosis/assessment alignment, medications and orders, coding and billing documentation, CPT/ICD support, medical necessity, and care-setting appropriateness

* Practice Operations & Workflow Support — patient lists, trackers, reporting, workflows, and back-office support

* Digital Presence & Fractional Marketing — social media, personal branding, newsletters, website content, healthcare content, and related digital marketing support



What You May Work On



Content will initially be developed for our founder's personal brand, company LinkedIn page, website, and newsletter.



You will also have the opportunity to work on similar content and digital-presence requirements for physicians and medical practices that engage us for these services.



Assignments can include:



* LinkedIn and other social media content

* Healthcare blogs and long-form articles

* Newsletters

* Thought-leadership and personal-branding content

* Website content

* Case studies and educational content

* Research into US healthcare trends, workflows, regulations, and practice challenges

* Developing original content ideas and maintaining a pipeline of relevant topics

* Adapting content and tone for different physicians, practices, executives, and brands



We are particularly interested in someone who can understand a subject, develop an original perspective, and write naturally for the intended audience rather than simply producing generic content from a brief.



What We're Looking For



* US Registered Nurse (USRN) — active or previously registered

* Currently based in the Philippines

* Excellent written English and strong natural writing ability

* Good understanding of the US healthcare system and medical practice environment

* Strong research and fact-checking skills

* Ability to simplify complex healthcare subjects without compromising accuracy

* Ability to independently identify relevant topics and content opportunities

* Ability to adapt writing style and voice for a founder, company, physician, or medical practice

* Reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently



Experience with healthcare content writing, LinkedIn, personal branding, newsletters, social media management, website/SEO content, or writing for physicians and healthcare organizations will be an advantage.



A Note About AI



We are looking for a writer first.



AI tools can be used for research, brainstorming, fact-finding, and improving efficiency. We are not looking for someone who primarily relies on AI to generate their writing.



Original thinking, natural writing, healthcare knowledge, research, and fact-checking are fundamental to this engagement.



How to Apply



Please submit:



* Your resume

* 2–3 samples of your original healthcare writing, such as healthcare-related LinkedIn posts, articles, blogs, newsletters, website content, or other professional healthcare content

* A brief description of your experience with the US healthcare system

* Your current or previous USRN status

* Any relevant experience with LinkedIn, healthcare content, newsletters, websites, social media, or personal branding



Paid Writing Assignment



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a fixed-fee paid writing assignment.



The assignment will include:



* 1 LinkedIn post based on a healthcare topic provided by us

* 1 LinkedIn post on a US healthcare or medical-practice-related topic selected and researched independently by the writer

* 1 healthcare blog/article of approximately 800–1,000 words

* 1 short newsletter of approximately 400–600 words

* 5–6 relevant content ideas for future LinkedIn posts, blogs, articles, or newsletters

* 1 revision of a submitted piece based on our feedback



Sources should be provided for factual, regulatory, statistical, coding, billing, or other healthcare-specific claims used in the content.



Paid Assignment Fee: USD 75



The USD 75 is a fixed fee for the complete assessment assignment. It compensates candidates for the time spent completing the assessment and does not represent a per-post, per-article, hourly, or future freelance rate.



Ongoing Engagement



The initial engagement will be project-based.



For the right writer, our intention is to continue with regular paid assignments covering LinkedIn content, newsletters, blogs, articles, website content, personal branding, and content for our healthcare clients.



Rates and scope for ongoing project work will be agreed separately and will not be calculated based on the assessment fee.



As the volume and scope of work develop, we will also evaluate transitioning the role into full-time employment.



Engagement: Paid Freelance / Project-Based

Work Arrangement: Remote

Location: Philippines Only

Paid Assessment: USD 75 fixed fee

title: CFD Modeller (WFH)

You will work on a variety of commercial, industrial, residential, and specialist projects requiring detailed performance-based analysis and engineering solutions.

Undertake smoke movement and smoke exhaust modelling.

Perform temperature and heat transfer analysis throughout buildings.

Assess HVAC and mechanical ventilation performance.

Model smoke hazard management systems, stair pressurisation systems, and atrium smoke control systems.

Interpret simulation results and provide engineering recommendations.

Prepare technical reports and supporting documentation.

Work closely with engineers, consultants, contractors, and clients to develop practical solutions.



Skills & Experience

Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Fire Safety Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or similar.

Proven experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modelling.



Strong understanding of:

Airflow and ventilation systems

Smoke control and smoke exhaust systems

Building thermal performance

Heat transfer and fluid mechanics

Mechanical services design

Preferred Software Experience

ANSYS Fluent

FDS (Fire Dynamics Simulator)

PyroSim

OpenFOAM

STAR-CCM+

SimScale

Similar CFD modelling platforms



Desirable Experience

Performance-based design and analysis.

Fire engineering and smoke management projects.

NCC and Australian Standards compliance.

Commercial, industrial, healthcare, education, or mixed-use developments.



What We're Looking For

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and manage projects.

Excellent technical report writing skills.

Confidence communicating complex modelling outcomes to technical and non-technical stakeholders.



To Apply

CFD software proficiency

Relevant project experience

Availability



Candidates with direct experience in smoke exhaust modelling, smoke movement analysis, and building airflow simulations are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Supply & Inventory Managment
description:
# Supply & Inventory Management Manager



---



## ?? Please Read Before Applying



**Do not apply before reading this advert and the requirements in full.**



We are hiring for quality, not volume. This is a central, high-trust role, and the calibre of the person matters more to us than the number of applications we receive. As such:



- Please read the **entire** job description and the **Required Skills & Qualifications** before applying.

- **Generic, copy-paste, mass-sent, or obviously AI-generated applications will not be considered.** We can tell, and we won't respond.

- Only apply if you genuinely meet the core requirements and are able to evidence them.

- This advert contains a **specific instruction** you must follow when applying (see *How to Apply* at the bottom). Applications that ignore it will be discarded without review — this is the first test of the attention to detail the role demands.



This role lives and dies by accuracy, reconciliation, and attention to detail — so our hiring process starts the same way. If that already sounds like your kind of standard, read on.



---



## Overview



We are looking for an experienced Supply & Inventory Management Manager to take ownership of stock across a group of companies operating from multiple locations. This is a central, cross-functional role responsible for ensuring the right products are in the right place at the right time, across both physical warehouses and online marketplaces.



You will sit at the heart of our operations, working across several ERP systems and sales channels to forecast demand, manage replenishment, control stock levels, and keep data accurate and reconciled across the group. Your decisions will directly drive availability, cash flow, and profitability, while reducing overstock, stockouts, and tied-up capital.



This role suits someone who is highly numerate, systems-literate, and comfortable holding the bigger picture across multiple entities while also getting into the detail of individual SKUs, lead times, and supplier performance.



## Key Responsibilities



### Group-Wide Inventory Oversight

- Take overall responsibility for inventory across multiple companies, brands, and physical locations within the group.

- Maintain a single, reliable view of stock across all entities, reconciling discrepancies between systems, warehouses, and sales channels.

- Set and maintain minimum and maximum stock levels, safety stock, and reorder points for each location and channel.

- Implement consistent stock control processes, cycle counts, and stock takes across all sites.



### Demand Forecasting & Planning

- Forecast demand at SKU, channel, and location level using historical sales data, seasonality, promotions, and market trends.

- Factor in product lead times, supplier reliability, and manufacturing or shipping windows when planning purchasing and replenishment.

- Balance availability against working capital, avoiding both stockouts and excess holding.

- Plan ahead for peak periods, new product launches, and promotional activity across the group.



### ERP Systems & Data Management

- Manage and coordinate inventory data across multiple ERP systems used by different companies in the group.

- Ensure stock, purchasing, and sales data is accurate, consistent, and synchronised between systems and channels.

- Identify opportunities to standardise, integrate, or improve ERP and inventory workflows across the group.

- Act as a key point of contact for system data integrity, troubleshooting mismatches and driving process improvement.



### Marketplace & Online Channel Coordination

- Oversee inventory allocation and synchronisation across online marketplaces such as Amazon, Shopify, and TikTok Shop.

- Ensure stock is correctly distributed and listed across channels to maximise availability and sales without overselling.

- Coordinate with fulfilment and channel teams to align listings, stock feeds, and replenishment with demand.

- Monitor channel performance and adjust allocation strategies to protect margins and service levels.



### Replenishment & Lead Time Management

- Own the end-to-end replenishment process, raising and managing purchase orders in line with demand and lead times.

- Track inbound stock, follow up on overdue deliveries, and manage exceptions such as delays, shortages, or damaged goods.

- Continuously review supplier lead times and reliability, feeding this into planning and reorder logic.



### Supplier, 3PL & Warehouse Coordination

- Act as the main point of contact between suppliers, prep centres, and 3PL/warehouse partners across locations.

- Coordinate shipment schedules, inbound bookings, and stock transfers between sites and entities.

- Manage returns, damaged or missing goods, and associated supplier claims or refunds.

- Build strong working relationships with suppliers to improve terms, reliability, and responsiveness.



### Reporting & Analysis

- Develop and maintain key reporting on stock levels, stock value, turnover, ageing, availability, and forecast accuracy.

- Provide clear, regular reporting to leadership on inventory health and risks across the group.

- Use data to identify slow-moving and dead stock, recommend actions, and continuously improve inventory efficiency.

- Track and report on key metrics such as stock turn, sell-through, fill rate, and days of cover.



## Required Skills & Qualifications

- Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience in inventory, supply chain, or stock management, ideally across multiple locations or entities.

- Proven experience working with ERP and inventory management systems, including reconciling data across more than one platform.

- Strong demand forecasting and planning skills, with a solid grasp of lead times, reorder logic, and safety stock.

- Highly numerate and analytical, comfortable working with large datasets and turning them into clear decisions.

- Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel/Sheets) and confidence with reporting and data tools.

- Experience managing inventory across online marketplaces such as Amazon, Shopify, or TikTok Shop.

- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across companies and locations.

- Strong communication and coordination skills, comfortable liaising with suppliers, 3PLs, and internal teams.



## Desirable Skills

- Experience working across a group structure with several companies, brands, or trading entities.

- Familiarity with multiple ERP systems and an understanding of how to integrate or standardise them.

- Knowledge of 3PL and prep centre operations.

- Experience with multichannel inventory or listing tools that sync stock across marketplaces.

- Understanding of cash flow and working capital implications of inventory decisions.

- A continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to streamline processes and systems.



## Benefits

- Central, high-impact role with visibility across the whole group.

- Opportunity to shape inventory and supply processes across multiple companies and channels.

- Fast-paced, growing business with real ownership and autonomy.

- Ongoing professional development and growth opportunities.



This position is ideal for someone who is organised, data-driven, and confident managing complexity across multiple companies, systems, and sales channels. If you enjoy bringing order to moving parts and using data to keep a growing operation stocked, efficient, and profitable, this role offers a challenging and rewarding opportunity.



---



## How to Apply



We review every application against the standards this role requires, so please make it easy for us to say yes:



1. **Start your application with the word "RECONCILED"** — as the first line of your message or your
 subject line. This confirms you have read the advert in full. **Applications that do not include this word will not be reviewed.**

2. Attach your **CV**.

3. Include a **short note (no more than a few paragraphs)** covering:

   - Your relevant inventory / supply chain / stock management experience, especially across **multiple locations, entities, or ERP systems**.

   - One example where your work directly improved **availability, cash flow, or stock accuracy** — with numbers if you can.

   - Your **notice period** and **salary expectation**.



Please keep it genuine and specific to you. We'd rather read three honest paragraphs about real work than a polished template that could have been sent to anyone.

What you’ll be doing



We are currently onboarding a new brand with approximately 17 Amazon listings that need to be completely optimised.

* ChatGPT

* Helium 10

* Higgsfield

* Other design/research tools where required

* Amazon SEO and keyword research

rather than simply completing a checklist.



The role

title: MSP IT Support Technician – Microsoft 365 / Intune / Security
description:
Senior MSP IT Support Technician – Microsoft 365 / Intune / Security



We are an Australian Managed Service Provider looking for an experienced IT Support Technician / Microsoft 365 Administrator to join our team remotely from the Philippines.



This is not an entry-level help desk position. We are looking for someone who has previously worked for an MSP and is comfortable taking ownership of technical issues, dealing directly with Australian clients, and working across multiple customer environments.



A major requirement of this position is responsiveness. During your working hours, you will be expected to actively monitor the support queue, acknowledge new tickets promptly and begin working on issues without needing to be chased.



What You'll Be Doing

Provide Level 1 and Level 2 remote technical support

Monitor and manage the MSP ticket queue

Take ownership of tickets through to resolution

Communicate directly with Australian clients

Troubleshoot Windows 10/11 desktops and laptops

Microsoft 365 administration and troubleshooting

Build new Microsoft 365 tenants from scratch

Configure Microsoft Entra ID

Configure MFA and Conditional Access

Configure Microsoft Intune from scratch

Create and manage Intune configuration and compliance policies

Configure Windows Autopilot and device enrolment

Deploy applications through Intune

Configure Microsoft Defender and Microsoft 365 security policies

Manage Exchange Online, mail flow, shared mailboxes and permissions

Administer SharePoint and OneDrive

Perform Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations

Migrate users, Exchange Online mailboxes and shared mailboxes

Assist with SharePoint, OneDrive and file migrations

Configure users, groups, licences and permissions

Troubleshoot Active Directory and Group Policy

Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP and general networking issues

Support firewalls, switches, wireless networks and VPNs

Support Windows Server environments

Basic Hyper-V and virtual machine administration

Monitor backups and perform/verify restores

Patch and maintain endpoints and servers

Document client environments, solutions and procedures

Escalate critical issues appropriately

Security Experience



Experience with our security stack would be highly regarded:



SentinelOne Complete

Huntress ITDR / SIEM

ThreatLocker

Axcient Microsoft 365 Backup

Check Point Harmony

Microsoft Defender

Microsoft Entra ID security, MFA and Conditional Access



You do not need to have experience with every product above, but strong endpoint security and Microsoft 365 security experience is important.



MSP Experience Is Important



We are specifically looking for someone who understands how an MSP operates.



You should be comfortable with:



Supporting multiple clients and environments

Working from a PSA/ticketing system

Prioritising tickets based on urgency and impact

Remote monitoring and management tools

Accurate time and ticket documentation

Following SOPs while also being able to troubleshoot independently

Working within SLAs

Recognising when an issue needs escalation

Taking ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next

Communication & Customer Service



Excellent spoken and written English is essential.



You will communicate directly with Australian customers, so we need someone who is:



Friendly and professional

Confident speaking with customers

Patient with non-technical users

Able to explain technical issues clearly

Comfortable making and receiving support calls

Proactive with customer updates

Calm when dealing with urgent problems

What We're Looking For



Ideally you will have:



3+ years professional IT support experience

Previous MSP experience

Strong Microsoft 365 administration experience

Strong Intune and Entra ID experience

Experience building Microsoft 365 environments from scratch

Experience performing tenant-to-tenant migrations

Strong Windows troubleshooting skills

Good networking knowledge

Experience supporting Windows Server environments

Understanding of cybersecurity best practices

Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

Excellent written and spoken English

Reliable internet connection and working environment



Most importantly, we need someone who is reliable, available and responsive during their agreed working hours.



We don't want someone who simply waits for tasks to be assigned. We want someone who watches the queue, sees a problem come in, takes ownership and starts working on it.



To Apply



Please include:



How many years you have worked for an MSP.

Your Microsoft 365 experience.

Your experience with Intune and Entra ID.

Whether you have built a Microsoft 365 tenant from scratch.

Details of any tenant-to-tenant migrations you have personally performed.

Which of the security products listed above you have used.

Your experience with Windows Server, networking and firewalls.

The PSA/RMM platforms you have used.

An example of a difficult technical problem that you personally diagnosed and resolved.

Your current employment situation and availability.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.



Please don't simply send a generic application. Tell us what you have actually administered yourself, particularly within Microsoft 365, Intune and MSP environments.



This is an opportunity for the right person to become an important part of a growing Australian MSP and take on greater technical responsibility as the business grows.

title: Print Production Artist, Promotional Products + Large Format
description:
Role summary



You take approved artwork and build press-ready and manufacturer-ready files that match each supplier’s template and specification exactly.





Responsibilities:



 • Build print-ready files for canopy tents, table covers, retractable and vinyl banners, step and repeat backdrops, drinkware, writing instruments, and trade show booth components

 • Work directly from supplier dielines and specification sheets

 • Deliver native Illustrator and Photoshop files plus press-ready PDFs

 • Handle bleeds, safe zones, imprint areas, trim marks, and fold and seam allowances correctly per product

 • Manage color correctly: CMYK conversion, spot color specification, and imprint color matching where the supplier requires it

 • Prepare vector art at correct scale for large-format output and outline type where required

 • Review supplier proofs and mark corrections





Must have:



 • Demonstrated production art experience in a print shop, sign shop, wrap shop, or promotional products supplier

 • Portfolio with at least two case studies showing files you prepared and the finished manufactured product

 • Expert Illustrator and Photoshop

 • Fluent with dielines, imposition, bleed and safe zone standards, and press-ready PDF export presets

 • Correct color management practice, including spot color and imprint color specification

 • Meticulous attention to specification detail. On this work, a small error becomes a physical reprint





Nice to have:



 • Experience with US promotional products suppliers and their template systems

 • Large format and grand format output experience

 • CorelDRAW, which some suppliers still require



Start your application with the words DIELINE on the first line. Applications without it are deleted unread.



Screening questions:



 1. Send two examples of production files you built plus a photo of the manufactured result. 

 2. A supplier sends a dieline for a 10x10 canopy tent. What are the first things you verify before starting? 

 3. A client supplies a logo as a 600px PNG for a 8ft step and repeat. What do you do? 

 4. Explain when you specify a spot color versus CMYK build on a promotional imprint.

 5. Which suppliers’ template systems have you worked with directly?

 6. What is your typical turnaround from approved art to press-ready file, and how do you quote?

title: Expert YouTube Longform Video Editor
description:
We are looking for an expert-level YouTube Video Editor who can create premium, retention-focused long-form content for top creators and brands. This role is best suited for editors who understand high-quality YouTube storytelling in the style of channels such as Vox, Johnny Harris, Cleo Abram, and other documentary/explainer-style creators. We are not looking for basic editors, short-form-only editors, or editors who simply add cuts and captions. We are looking for someone with strong creative judgment, technical skill, and the ability to turn raw footage and direction into a polished, engaging, and thoughtful YouTube video. The ideal editor understands pacing, story structure, audience retention, visual clarity, motion graphics, sound design, and how every editing choice affects the viewer’s experience.



Responsibilities



Edit high-quality long-form YouTube videos for creators, brands, and educational content.

Build strong hooks that make viewers want to keep watching.

Shape raw footage into a clear and engaging story.

Use B-roll, archival footage, graphics, music, sound design, and visual references intentionally.

Create clean motion graphics, maps, text animations, callouts, and visual explanations when needed.

Improve pacing, flow, clarity, and retention throughout the video.

Follow creative direction while also bringing your own strong editorial judgment.

Apply feedback quickly and professionally.

Work with creative leads, producers, and post-production teams to meet high creative standards.

Deliver polished edits on time in a fast-moving YouTube-first environment.



Qualifications



Strong experience editing long-form YouTube videos.

Expert-level skill in Adobe Premiere Pro.

Expert-level skill in Adobe After Effects and motion graphics.

Good understanding of Photoshop or other Adobe Creative Suite tools.

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts.

Ability to create documentary, explainer, talking-head, educational, or creator-style edits.

Strong use of B-roll, archival footage, visual references, graphics, sound design, and music.

Understanding of audience retention, viewer engagement, and YouTube performance.

Experience editing high-performing or high-quality content for creators, agencies, brands, or media companies.

Ability to work with feedback, revisions, and tight deadlines.

Strong attention to detail and clean technical execution.

Reliable computer/workstation setup and strong internet connection.



This Role Is Not For



Entry-level editors.

Editors with only short-form reel experience.

Editors with only wedding, corporate, event, or basic social media editing experience.

Editors who are not comfortable with long-form YouTube content.

Editors who only follow instructions but do not bring creative judgment.

Editors who cannot work with feedback or tight deadlines.

Editors who do not have strong Premiere Pro and After Effects skills.



Benefits



Work from anywhere! We’re a 100% remote team.

A quarterly wellness reimbursement

20 days of paid time off annually.

12 additional holidays per year.

Unlimited sick and bereavement leave.

Working for a company that is values-oriented and committed to positive social impact.

Unlimited reimbursement on book purchases for self-education.

Gifts/cash bonuses on birthdays, work anniversaries, and other work-related achievements.

Working directly with some of the largest brands on the planet.



Additionally, Dragonfruit is highly committed to offering all our team members opportunities for growth and mobility within the company. This could include moving up to Lead Short-Form or Long-Form Editor, Director of the Editing Department, Post-Production Supervisor, or even Creative Director or beyond! (Of course, all of these positions come with pay increases.)

?

If you're ready to join Dragonfruit and play a role in the future of YouTube, submit your application now!

title: E-commerce Account Coordinator | Product Listing, Store Builds & Client Support
description:
About us



FLYP is a UK-based AI-native merch platform. We build branded merch stores for companies - new-hire kits, event swag, employee gifting — and our B2B side is growing quickly. We're looking for an e-commerce account coordinator to join a small operations team, reporting to our Head of Operations.



What you'll do



- Samples for prospective clients: Design and order the sample, share tracking with our sales lead, and schedule the follow-ups.



- Artwork and print-file checks: Chase clients for their logos and assets, then check every file against what each print method can actually handle (DTG, all-over print, embroidery) and flag problems before anything goes into production.



- Samples, proofs and mockups for live clients: Create the products, share proofs for approval, collate the client's feedback, order samples and share tracking.



- Product creation and catalogue: Build products, add them to shops, write descriptions, set up size charts and pricing - plus ongoing additions and removals on live client stores.



- A fixed two-hour daily window processing incoming orders, supporting our e-commerce team.



- Process one-off bulk and custom orders for client accounts



You'll be great at this if you have



- 2+ years in e-commerce operations, product listing, or as an e-commerce VA



- Hands-on product creation experience on print-on-demand platforms (Printify, Printful, Gelato or similar)



- A good eye for mockups and proofs — you can put a design on a product, spot when it looks wrong, and present it cleanly to a client



- Working knowledge of print methods and their limits.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Description



We are hiring a Business Development Manager to own and manage the majority of our digital business. This role is ideal for someone with a strong small business background who is comfortable managing day-to-day operations and stepping into the details when needed.

This is a hands-on role. We are not looking for a high-level executive who operates far from execution. We are looking for someone who can manage and do.



Responsibilities

• Platform Ownership: Owning the end-to-end e-commerce operation across Amazon as the primary platform.  

• Vendor & Agency Management: Acting as the main point of contact for agencies and third-party vendors, including managing vendor contacts and leading negotiations.  

• Daily Operations: Overseeing technical, operational, and day-to-day e-commerce activities, including product additions, integrations, and customer service escalations.  

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Representing the company on technical, operational, and integration-related calls, and coordinating with in-person staff regarding e-commerce operations.  

• Stakeholder Communication: Communicating clearly with company owners on progress, issues, and priorities.  Problem Solving: Getting hands-on when needed to resolve technical or operational issues and unblock operations.



Platforms and Experience Required

• Experience with Amazon is strongly preferred. 

• Exposure to Walmart or eBay is a plus but not required.  

• Comfort managing integrations, apps, and technical workflows.  

• Proven experience working with agencies, external partners, and managing vendor negotiations.



Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, E-commerce, or a related field is preferred.  

• Experience managing or supporting marketplace platforms such as Amazon, Etsy, eBay, etc.  

• Background working in product-based or multi-channel e-commerce businesses.  

• Operational Skills

• Strong understanding of end-to-end e-commerce operations, workflows, and vendor relationship management.  

• Able to manage day-to-day execution and priorities independently.  

• Comfortable working remotely and independently with minimal supervision.  

• Ability to work fully during Central Standard Time (CST) business hours.  

Nice to Have Skills

• Experience with additional third-party marketplace platforms. 

• Familiarity with e-commerce integrations, apps, and third-party tools. 

• Exposure to international e-commerce operations or cross-border selling.  

• Comfortable supporting or overseeing digital marketing initiatives in partnership with specialists or agencies.  

• Experience helping scale or integrate new brands or acquisitions into an existing e-commerce platform.



Ideal Candidate Profile

• Comes from a small business or growing company environment.  

• Is comfortable wearing multiple hats and operating without being “too high level”.  

• Is not afraid to get into the operational, technical, or negotiation details.  

• Can grow with the company as we scale and potentially acquire other businesses. 



We offer performance-based increase and HMO, as part of our many perks and benefits.



***Very important: Do take note that the applicant is required to share their updated CV with appropriate access. Applicants who are non-compliant with this will be automatically ignored.***

title: Graphic Designer, Marketing Collateral + Web/Social Assets
description:
We are a US-based digital marketing agency looking for a designer who produces client-ready marketing collateral and on-brand digital assets. Portfolio with case studies is required.



Role summary



You produce the downloadable and sent assets that carry the brand: decks, one-pagers, case studies, ebooks, catalogs, and direct mail. You also produce website imagery and reusable social templates. You work from written briefs and existing brand guidelines.





Responsibilities



 • Pitch decks and sales presentations

 • Flyers, one-pagers, and leave-behinds

 • Case study layouts, both web and PDF

 • Ebooks, guides, and gated downloadable resources

 • Product catalog layout

 • US direct mail postcard design, built correctly for postal specifications

 • Website imagery, section graphics, and hero assets

 • Social image templates that non-designers can reuse without breaking them

 • Enforcing brand guidelines across every asset, including type scale, color, spacing, and logo usage





Must have



 • 3 or more years designing marketing collateral in an agency or in-house marketing team

 • Portfolio with at least two case studies showing the brief, your role, and the finished work

 • Demonstrated multi-page layout skill. Decks and ebooks, not just single social graphics

 • US direct mail postcard experience, with correct handling of trim, bleed, safe area, and mailing panel requirements

 • Adobe Creative Suite, particularly InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop. Your capability must extend beyond template-based tools

 • Ability to work inside an existing brand system rather than redesigning it

 • Strong written English for brief comprehension and feedback discussion





Nice to have



 • Canva, for producing templates the wider team can edit

 • Presentation tools such as Gamma

 • Figma

 • B2B and professional services design background



Start your application with the words BLEED LINE on the first line. Applications without it are deleted unread.



Screening questions

 1. Send links to two multi-page layouts you designed. Not social graphics.

 2. Describe the last US direct mail postcard you designed. What size, and how did you handle the mailing panel and safe area?

 3. You receive a brief with a brand guideline PDF and a rough outline. The brand’s specified body font does not support a language the client needs. What do you do?

 4. Which Adobe applications do you use weekly, and what do you use each for? 

 5. Describe your file organization and handoff process when someone else has to pick up your working file.

 6. Estimate turnaround for a 12-page ebook layout from approved copy and approved brand guidelines.

 7. What other work do you currently have and how many hours weekly?

title: Travel Research Virtual Assistant
description:
Intro

We are looking for a Virtual Assistant to help with manual research for travel articles about Asia. We are building travel guide websites on both a .dk and a .com domain, and we need help preparing structured research for new articles. 



The position is project-based for 6 months, with the possibility of extension.



Main role

Your main task will be to research travel topics for articles about Asia. The current focus is Thailand, Vietnam and other parts of Southeast Asia, but later the websites may also cover destinations such as Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Malaysia and Japan.



This is mainly a research role. We are looking for someone who is very good at finding reliable information, enjoys details and can work in a structured way.



Main responsibilities

x Research travel topics for new articles

x Find reliable sources, preferably official websites when possible

x Collect useful travel information such as location, transport, opening hours, prices, highlights and practical tips

x Compare information from different sources when needed

x Prepare clear research notes in Google Docs

x Add relevant source links

x Work with our content spreadsheet in Google Sheets

x Use ChatGPT Business or similar tools to help structure research notes

x Support our content and publishing team with small ad hoc tasks when needed



Most article research tasks will typically take around 30 minutes to 1 hour. More detailed topics may take up to 2 hours. 

The most important thing is that the research is useful, accurate and well structured.



Requirements

x Strong online research skills

x Good written English

x Very good attention to detail

x Ability to find and evaluate reliable sources

x Comfortable using Google Docs and Google Sheets

x Comfortable working with ChatGPT Business or similar tools

x Ability to work independently from home with minimal supervision

x Reliable and able to meet deadlines

x Good communication skills

x Open to sharing ideas and suggesting improvements

x Interest in travel is a strong advantage

x Basic SEO knowledge is a plus, but not required

x WordPress experience is a plus, but not required



Work setup

x 15 hours per week

x Working hours distributed Monday-Friday. Some overlap with Danish business hours is preferred for communication, but the role is otherwise flexible.

x Remote work from home

x Project-based position for 6 months

x Possibility of extension

x Test task



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short travel research test before hiring. This is so we can see your research quality, structure and ability to find useful sources.



About us

We are a small Danish travel agency established in 2010. We specialize in tailor-made travel to Asia, including Thailand, Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, Myanmar, Indonesia, Malaysia, Sri Lanka and Japan. We arrange travel for both individuals and groups.



We have a flat organizational structure and value people who can work independently, communicate clearly and suggest improvements when they see better ways to do things.



How to apply

Please send a short application including:



1. Your experience with online research

2. Your experience with travel-related work, if any

3. Your experience with Google Docs, Google Sheets and ChatGPT or similar tools

4. Why you think you would be a good fit for this role



If this sounds like the role for you, we’d love to hear from you!

description:

FLYP is an AI-native merch platform for modern companies. We help teams run premium branded employee stores, merch credits, AI-powered design, and global on-demand fulfillment without inventory, minimum orders, or operational complexity. 



The Role

We are looking for a highly capable and resourceful Founder Associate to work directly with the CEO across growth, enterprise sales, marketing, research, operations, and special projects.

This is a broad, high-ownership role for someone who is comfortable moving quickly, solving ambiguous problems, and taking initiatives from idea to execution. Your focus will be helping drive FLYP's enterprise growth while reducing the operational workload on the CEO.

- Support enterprise sales, prospecting, pipeline management, and follow-up.

title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer (Motion Graphics / 2D Animation Focus) — Faceless YouTube Channel
description:
## Channel Overview

- Faceless YouTube channel — narrated content, no on-camera host

- Long-form, narrated, educational content (~20–30 min videos)

- Calm, trustworthy tone — not high-energy or clickbait-driven

- A fully written voiceover script is provided for every video



This is a **single, combined role** — one person handling both video editing/motion graphics and graphic design/branding for the channel.



## About the Role

You'll take a finished voiceover script and handle its full visual life: editing the video, building the motion graphics that explain it, and designing the channel's brand assets (logo, banner, thumbnails). This channel relies heavily on animated charts, comparisons, and explainer-style graphics, so **strong 2D animation and motion graphics skills are the top priority** — alongside solid graphic design and branding ability.



### What You'll Do



**Video Editing & Motion Graphics**

- Edit long-form videos synced to a provided script, with a clean, polished, calm finish

- Build 2D motion graphics and animated visuals that explain ideas and numbers clearly — comparison charts, simple data visualizations, animated diagrams, callouts, lower-thirds

- Source relevant, calm B-roll/stock footage that matches the tone of the narration

- Add captions, transitions, background music, and clean audio balancing

- Keep pacing calm and unhurried — no fast-cut or high-adrenaline editing style



**Graphic Design & Branding**

- Design the channel logo, banner/header, and overall visual identity

- Design clear, benefit-driven thumbnails for each video — no alarmist or sensational framing

- Establish and maintain brand guidelines: warm, muted color palette, rounded shapes, clean and readable typography, grounded imagery over flashy visuals

- Build a flexible template system for recurring graphic elements (both motion graphics templates and static design templates)

- Design supporting assets as needed (end screens, subscribe graphics, promo visuals)



### What You Need

- **Strong 2D animation / motion graphics skills (After Effects or equivalent) — the most important skill for this role**

- Proficiency in a major editing platform (Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut)

- Strong graphic design skills (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma, or similar)

- Ability to design a full brand system — logo, banner, thumbnails, templates — not just individual graphics

- Comfort building simple animated charts/graphs from data

- Strong sense of typography, contrast, and readability

- Restraint — knows when not to add unnecessary visual noise or hype elements

- Good English comprehension

- Reliable workstation for long-form video and design work



### Bonus Points

- Experience with explainer-style or educational video content

- Experience animating charts, graphs, or comparison visuals

- Experience designing for trust-driven or educational brands

- Understanding of YouTube CTR best practices without relying on sensational framing

- Familiarity with royalty-free stock platforms



---



## How to Apply

Message directly, or
 with the subject line:

**Video Editor & Graphic Designer Application – [Your Name]**



Please include:

- Two examples of motion graphics/2D animation work — links preferred

- Two examples of brand/logo/thumbnail design work

- Your relevant software/tools

- Your availability

title: B2B Lead Generation + Outreach Specialist
description:
We are a US-based digital marketing agency looking for someone to build pipeline through research, warm-network outreach, and community monitoring. This is not high-volume cold spam and we will not run it that way.



Role summary:



You research and build target lists, map warm paths into them, draft genuinely personalized outreach, monitor online communities where buyers describe the problems we solve, and route qualified interest to our onsite sellers. You do not close, and you do not price.





Responsibilities:



 • Build and enrich prospect lists against a defined ideal customer profile

 • Research members of business networking groups we belong to and map warm introduction paths

 • Draft personalized outreach on LinkedIn and
, referencing something specific and real about each prospect

 • Monitor
 groups and other communities for people actively seeking the services we provide, and surface those threads with a suggested response

 • Route qualified responses and booked interest to our onsite sellers with a full context summary

 • Log every touch, response, and outcome in our CRM with no gaps

 • Maintain a weekly activity and outcome report





Must have:



 • 2 or more years in B2B lead generation or business development, specifically for a digital marketing agency, consultancy, or professional services firm

 • Demonstrated results you can describe with real numbers: lists built, response rates, meetings sourced

 • Excellent written English. Your drafts go out under real names and must read like a person wrote them

 • Working knowledge of LinkedIn prospecting, including Sales Navigator search construction

 • Disciplined CRM habits. Untracked activity is treated as work not done

 • 3 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours





Nice to have:



 • Experience selling or generating leads for SEO, web, or revenue operations services specifically

 • Experience with a community monitoring or social listening tool

 •
 enrichment and verification tool experience

 • Experience working alongside networking organizations such as chambers of commerce or referral groups



Performance upside:





Beyond your hourly rate, this role includes performance bonuses. You earn a bonus for every qualified meeting that is actually held, and a larger bonus for every new client that signs from an opportunity you sourced. Meeting bonuses are paid on meetings that take place, not on meetings that get booked, because we care about the quality of who you bring us rather than the volume of calendar invites. Qualification criteria are written down and shared with you before your first day, so you always know exactly what counts.



Start your application with the words WARM INTRO on the first line. Applications without it are deleted unread.



Screening questions;



 1. Describe the last outbound program you ran. Target profile, volume, response rate, meetings booked. Real numbers.

 2. Build me a Sales Navigator search for operations leaders at 50 to 200 employee manufacturing companies in the US Northeast. Describe the filters you would set. 

 3. Write a 60-word LinkedIn connection message to a prospect who just posted about switching CRM platforms. 

 4. Someone in a
 group posts asking for agency recommendations. How do you respond so that it helps rather than reads as an ad? (Auto-disqualify: drops a link and a pitch.)

 5. How many connection requests per day do you consider safe on a warmed LinkedIn account, and why does the number matter?

 6. What do you log in a CRM after a prospect replies but says “not right now”? 

 7. What other work do you currently have and how many hours weekly?

your own judgment and creative instincts. We don't hand you a shot-by-shot timeline. Where you need

footage we didn't provide, you source it yourself (stock, B-roll, UGC-style clips). So you have

to be able to read a video and recreate its feel, not just follow step-by-step instructions.



You must have hands-on, proven experience with:



Ecommerce / DTC ad editing — this is non-negotiable; show us the ads

Both short-form AND long-form ad editing (advertorial / VSL-style 2–5 min videos)

Sourcing your own footage — stock libraries (Storyblocks, Artgrid, Envato, Pexels, etc.),

B-roll, and UGC-style clips that match a script beat

Matching a reference / style ad — watching an example and recreating its look, pacing

and structure (not following a shot-by-shot timeline)

CapCut and/or Submagic (auto-captions, beat-syncing, exports)

Talking-head / UGC ad editing (HeyGen avatar footage is a plus)

Fast turnaround at volume (multiple ads per week)





What we don't need: wedding/event editors, motion-graphics showpieces, color-grading reels, or

people whose only experience is long-form YouTube vlogs. If you haven't edited ecommerce ads before,

we're not a fit — please don't apply.



This role is for you if: you can watch a great ad and figure out why it works, you're fast and

consistent, you have good creative instincts but stay on-brief, and you communicate proactively when

something's unclear.



Pay: $800–1,000 / month depending on experience. Full-time, long-term, with raises for top

performers.



To apply — read carefully (we ignore applications that skip this):



Start your reply with the word "SCROLL-STOP" so we know you read this.

Send us as many ecommerce ADS as you can that you personally edited — we want to see a real

body of work, not one lucky example. Include both short-form and long-form if you have them.

These should be actual ads (not showreels, not client logos). For each, one line on what you did.

Tell us about a time you sourced footage yourself for an ad — where you found it and how you

chose it. Which stock libraries / sources do you use?

Tell us which tools you use and your typical turnaround for (a) a 30–45 second short-form ad and

(b) a 2–4 minute long-form ad.

One line: what makes an ecommerce ad keep someone watching past the first 3 seconds?



We reply to everyone who follows these 5 steps. Looking forward to seeing your work.

Solace AI (Solace Technologies LLC, US) is hiring appointment setters to call small US home-services businesses - HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors - and book a 15-minute call with our founder.



Please read the compensation section before applying. This is commission only. There is no base pay. If you need guaranteed weekly income, this role is not right for you, and I would rather you know that now than after two weeks.



WHAT YOU DO

We give you the list. You dial, get the owner curious, and book a short call. You do not close, you do not demo, and you never quote a price. Book it, log it, next number. Target
dials per day during US business hours.



THE LEADS

These are not scraped lists. They are contractors who recently pulled a building permit, which means they have work on the books right now - so you have a real, current reason to be calling. You never prospect and you never build lists. Everything is handed to you in our calling console with the reason for the call already attached.



COMPENSATION

10% of all revenue Solace collects from any client that came from an appointment you booked. That is the setup fee plus the first 3 months of recurring revenue, not just the first invoice.



Typical deal size is $1,000-$8,000 setup plus $500-$4,000 per month. One client that closes and pays usually works out to $250-$1,600+ for the setter. Amounts vary and none are guaranteed.



You are paid when Solace actually collects the money, not when the appointment is booked. Expect a gap of a few weeks between your first calls and your first payout. Please plan for that.



REQUIREMENTS

- Prior cold calling or appointment setting experience

- Your own way to dial US numbers. We do not provide a dialer.

- Reliable internet and a proper headset

- Availability during US business hours

title: Associate Client Success Manager

In August 2022, Propseller raised a US$12M Series A led by Vertex Ventures, the VC arm of Temasek, the investment company owned by the Government of Singapore and the Series A lead investor of Grab.



Propseller’s mission is to help people build wealth with real estate. We’re building an end-to-end real estate transaction platform and towards that goal, we started the journey by building a technology-powered real estate brokerage that is valuable, reliable and fairly priced. 



By elevating the most human part of the service with top in-house agents and industrialising all the rest with technology and centralised operations, we became Singapore's most loved real estate agent with an average Google My Business rating of 4.8/5 (800+ reviews). 



The next phase of the journey is to go from helping people sell their homes to becoming the No. 1 brand for people to move from one home to the next: sell, buy, and finance.



Find out more at: 
/careers/



Role Description



Associate Client Success Managers act as strategic and supportive partners to both property owners and buyers, ensuring an elite end-to-end client experience. You will work closely with top-performing Real Estate Consultants and internal experts to support clients at every stage of their journey. This includes smooth onboarding, scheduling property photo shoot and video shoot, creating beautiful property listings, helping buyers find their dream homes, coordinating viewings, and driving successful closings.



This is a hybrid role that blends client advisory, operational execution, and cross-functional collaboration. You will play a critical role in showcasing properties at their best, managing client expectations, and improving the speed and quality of each transaction. Whether supporting a homeowner selling a $500K unit or assisting a buyer searching for a $20M landed house, your contribution will directly impact satisfaction, conversion, and overall performance.



If you are motivated by service excellence, focused on execution, and passionate about making clients successful and happy, this role is for you.



Duties & Responsibilities



Deliver a Seamless and Elevated Client Journey



- Onboard Clients with Clarity and Care: Guide property owners and buyers through a structured and reassuring onboarding experience, laying the foundation for a premium and professional collaboration.

- Be the Client’s Trusted Partner: Maintain proactive communication, provide regular updates, and ensure every client feels supported and in control throughout their journey, from onboarding to closing.

- Maximise Client Satisfaction: Champion service excellence at every step, helping ensure that each interaction reinforces Propseller’s reputation for care, trust, and performance.



Orchestrate High-Quality Listing and Marketing Execution



- Oversee Listing Launches: Ensure each listing is activated with precision, by coordinating timelines and validating high-quality marketing assets, from compelling descriptions to polished visuals.

- Coordinate Marketing & Staging: Align photoshoot, staging, and advertising initiatives to showcase each property at its best and attract the right buyers.

- Drive Visibility Through Advertising Coordination: Support the execution of strategic ad campaigns to maximise visibility and generate strong buyer interest.



Support Buyer Search and Property Shortlisting



- Refine Search Criteria: Review and clarify the search criteria submitted by buyers to ensure alignment with their needs and expectations.

- Search and Shortlist Listings: Explore multiple property portals, confirm key details, and compile a tailored shortlist of relevant and available listings.

- Ensure Listing Relevance and Accuracy: Double-check listing availability and specifications to ensure every option shared is a realistic and high-quality fit.



Coordinate Viewings and Drive Performance



- Optimise Viewing Scheduling: Manage availability and logistics across clients, agents, and internal teams to ensure a high number of property viewings for each listing.

- Monitor Progress & Maintain 
ntum: Schedule strategic checkpoint calls and surface key performance insights to keep clients engaged and focused on results.

- Collaborate Across Functions: Act as the central link between Real Estate Consultants, marketing, and operations to ensure a seamless and high-performing client journey.



Ideal Candidate



You are sharp, proactive, and naturally earn trust. You thrive in fast-paced, client-facing environments where communication, organisation, and empathy are everything. You don’t just handle tasks, you anticipate needs, build genuine relationships, and turn challenges into opportunities.



With experience in roles like Client Success, Customer Service, Sales, or Marketing, you have learned how to read people, solve problems, and make things happen. You are not just looking for a job, you are looking to make a real impact and be part of a company reshaping the real estate experience from the ground up.



Requirements



- Education: Diploma or Bachelor degree required;

- Experience: 1 year experience required in a remote customer service role;

- Language Proficiency: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English;

- Technical Skills: Proficient in Google Suite and MS Office, with strong overall computer skills;

- Exceptional Communication Skills: You have a natural ability to connect with diverse clientele, adapting your communication style to build rapport and ensure clear, effective interactions;

- Organised and Multi-Tasking: You excel at time management and prioritising tasks, consistently completing work efficiently and on schedule;

- Fast and Detail-Oriented: With a meticulous eye for detail, you review your work carefully to ensure high quality while maintaining a quick turnaround;

- Client-Centric Approach: You genuinely enjoy interacting with clients and are dedicated to making Propseller clients successful through attentive, supportive service;

- Resilient and Persistent: You demonstrate resilience when facing challenges or pushback and have the determination to see tasks through to completion;

- Adaptable: You adapt with ease when things evolve. You stay focused and effective in every circumstance.



You Get



- Remote: Deliver output from the comfort of your home while contributing directly to a fast-growing, tech-enabled real estate company based in Singapore.

- Structured support & training: Get onboarded with clear guidance, regular check-ins, and ongoing coaching to help you thrive

- Performance-based bonus: Be rewarded directly for your results

- Above-market compensation: Receive competitive pay that reflects your skills and performance, significantly higher than local customer service contracts

- Exposure to startup culture: Join a high-performing and caring team that values initiative, learning, and collaboration, without the rigid structure of corporate environments

- Purpose & impact: Play a meaningful role in shaping the home-buying and selling experience of clients in one of life’s biggest milestones



Recruiting Process

5. Welcome Aboard! 



Compensation

Website builders

title: Customer Experience Representative
description:
Customer Experience Representative (VA) – Call Center



Who We Are?

Trojan Storage is the best self-storage operator in the business with over 50+ locations in the U.S today! Simply put, we have the best people in the workplace with our amazing culture, healthy benefits, and growth opportunities. 



Work Schedule 

40 Hour Work Weeks | 5 Days | 8 Hours per day

11:00 PM – 8:00 AM Philippine Time (PHT), Monday through Saturday, to align with the Company's normal business hours of 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (California). 

Sunday Schedule: 11:30 PM – 8:00 AM PHT to align with California's Sunday business hours of 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM PT. 

The work schedule may be adjusted by one hour during U.S. Daylight Saving Time changes to maintain alignment with California business hours.



Your Role:

Join our amazing call center today!  The Customer Experience Representative (CXR) is an independent contractor that will report directly to the Contact Center Manager. This individual will play an integral role in executing the overall growth and customer service strategy of Trojan Storage. The CXR will be the front line for new customers’ rentals as well as handling a variety of customer issues utilizing phone, SMS, chat, and
. The CXR must possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, as well as be enthusiastic about helping customers and driving satisfaction.



Your Responsibilities:

• Customer Experience: Delight customers through multichannel communications including phone,
, chat, and video. Become proficient in self-storage operations delivering empathetic communications to all our customers practicing First Contact Resolution (FCR). Handle and mitigate customer complaints with effective communication and proper documentation.  

• Sales: Achieve sales metrics on new rentals, leads, and conversion rates through inbound communications. Cross sell other products and services to meet the needs of our valued customers. 

• Collections: Take payments and assist customers with all delinquency needs ensuring proper documentation and compliance. 

• Efficiency: Drive performance through keeping efficiency ratios at standards. This includes managing average handle times, response times, and calls handled per day.

• Teamwork: Foster positive relationships with team members and leadership collaborating effectively on initiatives, meetings, and daily interactions.

• Punctuality & Attendance: Adhere to all schedules and meetings on time with no disruption to the contact center environment.  Be a reliable team member to support operational efficiency and team cohesion. 

• Interpersonal Skills: Communicate effectively with all internal stakeholders such as site personnel, District Managers, and within the contact center.



Qualifications

• Senior High School diploma or equivalent required.

• 1 Year of experience in a contact center environment or customer-support role

• Phone sales experience preferred. 

• Bilingual (Spanish) preferred.

• Proficiency in chat communication a plus.

• Ability to multi-task and manage time effectively.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience in conflict resolution and customer sales. 



Apply today to join one of the fastest growing self-storage operators in the business!

Independent Contractor Disclaimer



This opportunity is for an Independent Contractor (Virtual Assistant) position and is not an employment position with Andasol Management Inc. dba Trojan Storage or any of its affiliated companies. Services will be performed pursuant to an Independent Contractor Agreement, and nothing in this job posting or any subsequent agreement shall be construed as creating an employer-employee relationship. As an independent contractor, you will be responsible for all applicable taxes, government contributions, permits, insurance, and compliance with the laws and regulations of your country of residence. Independent contractors are not eligible for employee benefits, including but not limited to paid holidays, paid time off, overtime pay, sick leave, health benefits, retirement benefits, or 13th month pay.



This engagement is designed to provide full-time work of approximately 40 hours per week, with a regular schedule of Monday through Friday during the Philippine time zone, supporting U.S. Pacific Time business operations. From time to time, contractors may be required to attend virtual team meetings or training sessions that occur during U.S. business hours. Advance notice will be provided whenever reasonably possible to allow for scheduling.



Independent contractors are responsible for providing and maintaining their own computer, reliable high-speed internet connection, backup power and internet solutions (when feasible), and a professional, dedicated workspace suitable for conducting business. Andasol Management Inc. will provide a company-issued headset for business use.



Contractors are required to accurately record all hours worked using the Company's designated timekeeping platform, TimeProof. Compensation is paid bi-weekly on Tuesdays, provided the payment date does not fall on a U.S. holiday. The pay period consists of two consecutive workweeks beginning Sunday and ending Saturday. Contractors must submit their invoice for the completed pay period no later than 12:00 PM Pacific Time on the Tuesday immediately following the close of the pay period. Approved invoices will be processed for payment on that same day. Payments are issued through Payoneer.

title: Advanced Online Reputation Management (ORM) & Search Suppression Specialist
description:
Job Type: Project-Based with high possibility to be a Permanent Role

Location: Remote

Experience Level: Experienced / Specialist

Rate: $2500



About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Online Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist to assist with a sensitive and complex reputation-management matter involving negative/inaccurate information appearing in Google search results.



This is not a traditional SEO position.



We are specifically looking for someone with demonstrated experience in advanced ORM, search-result suppression, de-indexing strategy, legal takedown coordination, and high-authority content publishing.



The ideal candidate should understand how to approach complex reputation issues through a combination of legal, technical, SEO, content, and publisher-related strategies.



Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute an advanced online reputation management strategy.

- Analyze negative or inaccurate search results and determine the appropriate remediation strategy.

- Develop search suppression campaigns designed to reduce the visibility of unfavorable results.

- Evaluate whether specific pages may qualify for Google's available removal or legal-removal processes.

- Coordinate with legal counsel and/or relevant parties regarding supporting documentation and takedown efforts.

- Assist with requesting expedited recrawling after legitimate changes are made to affected webpages.

- Develop and publish authoritative, search-optimized content to strengthen positive search results.

- Identify high-authority platforms and assets that may support a reputation-management campaign.

- Monitor Google search results and indexing changes throughout the campaign.

- Provide regular reporting on progress, rankings, indexing, and search visibility.

- Recommend additional strategies when publisher cooperation, legal action, or SEO-based suppression is required.



The ideal candidate should have proven experience with several of the following:

- Advanced Online Reputation Management (ORM)

- Search suppression

- Search-result remediation

- De-indexing strategy

- Google search removal processes

- Legal takedown coordination

- Defamation or inaccurate-content remediation

- Technical SEO

- High-authority content publishing

- Content authority building

- Negative search-result suppression

- Working with attorneys or legal counsel

- Reputation management for executives, entrepreneurs, entertainers, athletes, attorneys, or public-facing individuals

- Managing complex search-result issues involving government websites, court records, news publications, or other authoritative sources



Important

- We are not looking for someone who only has experience with basic SEO or review management.

- Experience with keyword research, on-page SEO, backlinks, Google rankings, or removing negative Yelp/Google reviews alone is not sufficient for this position.

- We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate successful experience with complex ORM and search suppression cases.



Candidates should NOT claim to be able to:

"Remove anything from Google"

Guarantee that a webpage will be de-indexed

Guarantee removal of a search result within a specific number of hours or days

Guarantee that Google will remove a publicly accessible government or third-party webpage



We value candidates who understand the difference between removing a webpage, removing a webpage from Google's index, and suppressing a search result.



To Apply:

 me at

PLease follow the instructions. Thank you.

description:

title: AI Specialist
description:
I currently use CustomGPT.ai as the underlying platform for an AI Digital Patient Concierge deployed on clinic websites.



I'm looking for an experienced AI/API integration developer to help extend this functionality to voice, ideally using ElevenLabs or a similar voice AI platform.



The goal is to create an AI agent that can:



* Answer incoming telephone calls and have natural voice conversations with patients.

* Use the existing CustomGPT knowledge base/API to answer clinic-specific patient questions.

* Maintain conversational context throughout the interaction.

* Triage calls and transfer/escalate to a human receptionist when required.

* Accept a warm handover from a human receptionist and continue the conversation with the patient.

* Securely capture patient/contact details when required.

* Send captured details and relevant information to a CRM via API.

* Integrate with a clinic's appointment/booking system to check availability and book appointments for appropriate patients.

* Maintain appropriate conversation transcripts/logs for reporting.

* Continue to work alongside the existing website-based CustomGPT concierge.



CustomGPT has confirmed that its API can be used as the conversational and knowledge layer for a third-party voice platform such as ElevenLabs, including maintaining multi-turn conversation context. CustomGPT would handle the clinic knowledge and natural-language responses, while the voice platform/middleware would need to orchestrate telephony, structured data collection, CRM/booking API calls and human escalation.



**End-to-end technical ownership**



I'm not a developer and, provided the solution is commercially viable, my preference is to engage someone who can take technical ownership of the solution end-to-end—from architecture and development through to implementation, testing and ongoing maintenance.



I'm looking to manage the clinic relationship and service rather than personally maintain the underlying technical infrastructure.



**Reusable and scalable**



Importantly, I'm looking for the solution to be designed as a reusable and scalable architecture rather than a one-off integration for a single clinic.



The intention is to deploy the same core voice and integration framework across multiple clinic clients, with their individual knowledge bases, phone systems, CRM and booking systems configured as required.



**Security, privacy and compliance**



Security, privacy and compliance are critical requirements. As the solution may handle patient contact details, conversation transcripts and voice recordings, the architecture must be designed with Australian healthcare privacy and data-protection requirements in mind.



The proposed solution should clearly document:



* Where patient data, conversation transcripts and audio recordings are processed and stored.

* Whether any data is transferred, processed or stored outside Australia.

* Encryption in transit and at rest.

* Authentication and access controls.

* Data retention and deletion options.

* Third-party platforms and subprocessors that may have access to data.

* How sensitive information moves between the voice platform, CustomGPT, CRM, booking system and any middleware.

* Any security or privacy risks associated with the proposed architecture.



Please also identify any areas that would require independent legal, privacy, security or compliance review before deployment to Australian healthcare clients.



**Commercial viability and costs**



The solution needs to be commercially viable to deploy across multiple clinics. As part of your proposed architecture, I'd like a clear breakdown of the expected costs, including:



* Initial development cost for the reusable core solution.

* Expected implementation/configuration cost for each additional clinic.

* Ongoing technical support and maintenance costs.

* Platform subscriptions.

* Telephony and voice usage costs.

* Hosting or middleware costs.

* API, CRM and integration costs.

* Transcript/audio storage costs.

* Any additional security, privacy or compliance-related costs.

* Any other ongoing infrastructure or usage-based costs.



Where costs are usage-based, please explain how they are calculated and how they would scale with call volume.



**Ongoing opportunity**



For the right person, there is potential for an ongoing relationship implementing the solution across new clinic clients, developing additional integrations, troubleshooting issues and maintaining the underlying technical solution as the service grows.



Experience with CustomGPT, ElevenLabs Conversational AI, Twilio/SIP telephony, APIs/webhooks, CRM and appointment-system integrations, and workflow platforms such as n8n or Make would be highly regarded.



Please let me know:



* About any similar AI voice/telephony integrations you've built.

* How you would approach the architecture for this project.

* How you would make the core solution reusable across multiple clinic clients.

* What components would need to be configured or developed for each individual clinic.

* An indication of the development, implementation and ongoing operating costs involved.

* Whether you would be comfortable taking ongoing technical responsibility for the solution after deployment.
