title: Character Illustrator-Animator | AI Visual Producer
description:
Prismiera is building an identity-forward jewelry/e-com brand through worldbuilding. We're hiring a remote creative-production specialist for character design, animation, and charm.



We're looking for someone who can draw by hand as a baseline indicator for art fundamentals; whose work shows strong character taste — expression, gesture, emotional acting, aesthetic charm, and animation or storytelling instincts. AI tool experience is a plus, not a requirement. We can train the AI pipeline relatively quickly, but the artistic talent and execution ceiling we're looking for is not something we can teach. Therefore,



**We're especially interested in people who've built and sustained their own creative work — a channel, a webcomic, indie projects, a personal art practice, or deployed content for someone else with sustained self-directed shipping and creative exploration and ownership. If your background is more traditional (studio, agency, client work), that's fine too — we'll evaluate on the work itself.**



AI has collapsed the creative space into taste, artistic eye, experimentation, and speed of execution. So we're looking for execution discipline — you finish work, you iterate cleanly, you ship completed videos autonomously under shifting artistic demand, and you adapt quickly across different styles and mediums.



What you'll do



Steering, selecting, rejecting, refining, and sequencing AI-generated visuals so they match our shifting style demands, emotional tone, and character identity.



- Visual-audio judgment and strict curation of AI output

- Refine expressive character stills using AI tools, reference pools

- Generate motion video from curated stills using AI video tools (Seedance2, Kling — guidance provided)

- Time clips of varying styles to narration, and deliver finished 20–60 second character-led videos

- Curate ElevenLabs voiceover and attitude (guidance provided)

- Sequence and time motion clips against narration

- Keep recurring characters consistent across many pieces

- Help build reference systems and visual judgment language over time

- Document what worked, what failed, and why — so the system improves



Style direction

Character work with high emotional expressiveness — diverse emotional and stylistic grammar from shoujo/josei to shonen/seinen to other virality-native illustrated character storytelling styles. Work should feel alive and artist-directed, not randomly generated (your art has an opinionated, taste driven direction, not general). You can play across emotional registers — dramatic, comedic, melancholic, playful, action-driven.



We provide SOPs on content format and scripting, but having your own working sense of what makes content land + general virality sense, will make the process smoother.



You might be a fit if you

- Have visual substrate in character work — illustration, comics, animation, storyboards, VTuber assets, visual novels, AI character work, or another medium where expression and character consistency matter

- Can diagnose why a character feels off

- Sustain self-directed creative output

- Are curious about AI image and motion tools, even if you haven't used them extensively yet

- Can time visual beats to narration rhythm

- Communicate clearly and work well async



AI-assisted portfolios are welcome — we'll evaluate your execution.



Compensation

$800–$1,100 USD/month full-time depending on portfolio and trial performance. Higher long-term compensation available for candidates with autonomous judgment as we expand our worldbuilding and brand. We're looking for a long-term creative partner.



Trial period prior to confirmed engagement. Tool access and AI tool credits provided.



How to apply

Send:



Portfolio link — your best work. Ideally work you've deployed into your own channels or someone else's, or any creative project you've sustained over time, showcasing self-directed creative ownership.



Character or emotional pieces, showcasing your expressive range, charming aesthetic execution, etc.

Motion or sequence sample if available (animatic, short edit, Live2D/VTuber motion, AI motion, storyboard sequence, AE edits, etc)



Use at least 7 apply points.

description:
BRIEX INVESTMENTS LLC is looking for an experienced and reliable Real Estate Virtual Assistant based in the Philippines. This position will begin with a paid 10-hour trial and may grow into a long-term part-time or full-time role.

The VA will be responsible for government-list research, skip tracing, cold calling, text blasting, seller follow-up, lead qualification, appointment setting, CRM management, property research, and cash-buyer research.

Main Responsibilities

Government and Lead Research

Research official government and public-record sources for pre-foreclosures, probate, inherited properties, delinquent taxes, liens, code violations, vacant properties, evictions, fire damage, and other distressed-property situations.

Verify property addresses, parcel information, owners, mailing addresses, and LLC ownership.

Skip trace owners and prepare clean, accurate lead lists.

Remove duplicates, wrong records, and irrelevant properties.

Cold Calling

Cold call property owners using company-approved systems and scripts.

Speak naturally, build rapport, and understand the owner’s situation.

Determine whether the owner is interested in selling.

Ask about the property’s condition, repairs, occupancy, reason for selling, desired timeline, asking price, price flexibility, mortgage balance, liens, delinquent taxes, and all decision-makers.

Record calls and update detailed notes in the CRM.

Text Blasting

Upload approved lead lists into the company’s text-messaging platform.

Launch text-blasting campaigns using company-approved numbers, templates, schedules, and software.

Monitor and respond to incoming messages.

Classify responses as interested, follow-up, not interested, wrong number, or opt-out.

Continue conversations with interested owners and call them when appropriate.

Immediately honor all STOP, unsubscribe, do-not-call, and other opt-out requests.

Follow all company procedures, platform policies, and applicable communication regulations.

Lead Qualification and Appointment Setting

Call and qualify owners who respond positively to cold calls or text messages.

Build trust and uncover the seller’s motivation and specific needs.

Confirm that the person owns the property or has authority to sell.

Gather all relevant property and seller information.

Follow up consistently until the owner is ready.

Schedule qualified appointments with management.

Send appointment confirmations and update the company calendar.

Transfer urgent or highly motivated sellers when appropriate.

Provide management with complete notes, text conversations, and call recordings before every appointment.

Management will handle detailed negotiations, offers, contracts, and closings.

CRM and Follow-Up

Update the CRM after every call, text conversation, and follow-up.

Maintain an organized follow-up calendar.

Classify leads as unqualified, follow-up, warm, motivated, or appointment scheduled.

Ensure that no promising lead is forgotten.

Provide accurate daily and weekly activity reports.

Property Research

For qualified leads, collect preliminary information including:

Property characteristics and ownership history.

Beds, bathrooms, square footage, lot size, and year built.

Tax, mortgage, lien, and foreclosure information when available.

Recent comparable sales.

Estimated property value.

Known property condition or repair concerns.

Neighborhood, market, and flood-zone information when requested.

All values and estimates are preliminary. Management will make all final offer and contract decisions.

Cash-Buyer Research

Research active cash buyers purchasing similar properties in the property’s ZIP code and surrounding market.

Find recent cash purchasers, landlords, flippers, developers, investment companies, and LLC buyers.

Verify the buyer’s name, company, phone number,
, website, target areas, property preferences, price range, buyer type, and recent purchases whenever possible.

Record the source used to verify each buyer.

Prepare an organized cash-buyer report for management.

Do not include the property’s current owner as a potential buyer.

The VA will only research and organize cash-buyer information. The VA must not contact buyers, send property information, discuss pricing, or negotiate with them unless specifically authorized. Management will handle all buyer communication.

Required Lead Report

Every qualified lead transferred to management must include:

Owner’s name and verified contact information.

Property address.

Original lead source.

Reason for selling and level of motivation.

Property condition and occupancy.

Desired timeline.

Asking price and flexibility.

Known mortgage balance, liens, taxes, or foreclosure information.

All decision-makers.

Complete call and text history.

Call recordings.

Follow-up history.

Appointment date and time.

Recommended next action and any potential complications.

Daily Report

The VA must report:

Records researched and verified.

Owners skip traced.

Calls attempted and owners contacted.

Text messages sent and responses received.

Positive responses and opt-outs.

Meaningful seller conversations.

Follow-ups scheduled.

Qualified leads generated.

Appointments scheduled.

CRM records updated.

Cash buyers researched and verified.

Call recordings and completed tasks.

Requirements

Excellent spoken and written English with clear pronunciation.

Previous U.S. real estate cold-calling and text-messaging experience.

Ability to maintain natural conversations instead of reading scripts mechanically.

Experience with government records, skip tracing, lead generation, and cash-buyer research.

Experience with CRM systems and Google Sheets.

Familiarity with PropStream, BatchLeads, DealMachine, or similar platforms is preferred.

Reliable computer, professional headset, and stable high-speed internet.

Ability to work during agreed U.S. Eastern Time hours.

Comfortable using TimeProof and submitting call recordings and detailed reports.

Honest, organized, responsive, coachable, and interested in a long-term position.

Compensation

Starting compensation is $5 per hour.

The position will begin with a paid 10-hour trial. If performance is strong, it may continue part-time and later become full-time.

The VA will receive a $50 performance bonus for every qualified seller lead generated and worked by the VA that results in a fully executed purchase agreement between BRIEX INVESTMENTS LLC and the property owner.

The lead must be correctly documented in the company CRM. Duplicate leads and appointments that do not result in a signed purchase agreement do not qualify for the bonus.

How to Apply

Please provide:

A summary of your U.S. real estate experience.

Your cold-calling and text-blasting experience.

The government lists and public records you have researched.

How you find and verify active cash buyers.

The CRM, skip-tracing, dialer, SMS, and real estate platforms you have used.

A 60–90 second voice recording simulating the beginning of a call with a property owner.

Your internet speed-test result.

Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

Confirmation that you can use TimeProof and provide call recordings.

Begin your application with “BRIEX VA” to confirm you read the complete description.

title: Senior SEO Specialist
description:
We are a US-based digital marketing agency looking for a senior SEO specialist who can run a full technical audits for new leads, existing clients, work on architecting fixes, and feed into the development of the overall strategy. This is 15-20 hours per week to start, with a clear path to full-time.



Role summary:



You own SEO execution across our own properties and our client accounts. That includes diagnosing sites, implementing on-page and technical fixes in WordPress, owning local search presence, and building off-site visibility. You will also own our presence on one high-value community platform where AI search engines source answers, working from a playbook we have already written.





Responsibilities:



 • Run full site crawls with Screaming Frog and turn the export into a prioritized findings list with evidence, not a raw data dump

 • Produce prospect-facing audit findings on new business opportunities, on a defined turnaround

 • Implement on-page optimization: heading structure, content placement and sequencing on the page, internal linking, metadata, and answer-first formatting for AI Overview and answer-engine visibility

 • Build and validate schema markup, and troubleshoot rich result eligibility

 • Apply current experience, expertise, authoritativeness, and trust practices, and structure content for information gain rather than restating what already ranks

 • Own Google Business Profile management and directory citation building and cleanup across multiple local businesses

 • Execute off-site work: third-party platform publishing, digital PR, brand mention acquisition, and social surfaces that feed search visibility

 • Manage a disclosed, community-first presence on a major discussion platform, following our existing playbook and its posting ratios

 • Pull, interpret, and report from Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console

 • Implement everything hands-on in WordPress using Rank Math





Must have:



 • 3 or more years of SEO in an agency environment, working across multiple client accounts and multiple industries at the same time

 • Fluent, independent use of Screaming Frog. You must be able to explain what you check first in a 400-page crawl and why

 • Expert-level WordPress, including Rank Math, and comfort with Elementor. Yoast familiarity is fine as a substitute background

 • Working command of Ahrefs. Exposure to Semrush, SpyFu, or SEOptimer is a plus, not a requirement

 • Demonstrable Google Analytics 4 and Search Console skill, including reading a query report and diagnosing a traffic drop

 • Hands-on local SEO experience: Google Business Profile, citation building, NAP consistency at scale

 • Genuine off-page experience placing content and earning mentions on sites you do not own

 • Written English strong enough to write a findings summary a client executive will read

 • Reliable internet and a machine that can run Screaming Frog on large crawls

Nice to have

 • Experience optimizing specifically for AI Overviews, ChatGPT, or Perplexity citation

 • Surfer SEO

 • Experience with regulated or considered-purchase B2B verticals

 • Community platform participation history under a real account with real karma





Finalist stage



Finalists complete a paid audit assignment using their own tools and systems before any offer is made. This is real paid work, not spec work.



Start your application with the words CRAWL BUDGET on the first line. Applications without it are deleted unread.



Screening questions

 1. Walk me through the first five things you check when you open a Screaming Frog export of a 400-page site. Why those five first?

 2. A client’s organic traffic dropped 40 percent over six weeks. Their rankings barely moved. What is your diagnostic sequence?

 3. Describe a specific schema implementation you built and what result it produced.

 4. Describe how you have earned links or brand mentions on websites you do not own or control. Be specific about the method.

 5. How many Google Business Profiles have you personally managed at once, and what is your process for citation cleanup?

 6. What has changed in how you structure page content in the last 18 months because of AI search results?

 7. What are your current commitments? List every other client or employer and the hours each takes weekly. 

 8. What is your home internet speed and can your machine crawl a 5,000-URL site without failing?

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a skilled Node.js Developer to design, develop, test, and support serverless applications that power customer interactions within an AWS-based contact center platform. The role will focus on developing AWS Lambda functions that integrate with Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, APIs, CRM systems, and backend services to deliver secure, scalable, and intelligent IVR and self-service experiences. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Node.js, AWS serverless technologies, API integrations, and contact center solutions.



Key Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and maintain Node.js applications running on AWS Lambda.

· Build and enhance IVR and self-service workflows using Amazon Connect and Amazon Lex.

· Develop integrations between contact center platforms and enterprise applications, databases, CRM systems, and third-party APIs.

· Create reusable Lambda services to support authentication, routing, customer identification, case management, and self-service transactions.

· Develop RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures using AWS services.

· Implement secure coding practices, including encryption, authentication, authorization, and data protection controls.

· Participate in CI/CD pipeline development and deployment automation using GitHub and AWS DevOps services.

· Troubleshoot production issues and optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.

· Collaborate with solution architects, contact center engineers, QA teams, and business stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.

· Develop automated unit, integration, and regression tests for serverless applications.

· Create technical documentation, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks.



Required Qualifications

· Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

· 3+ years of Node.js development experience.

· 2+ years of hands-on AWS development experience.



· Experience developing and deploying AWS Lambda functions.

· Experience with Amazon Connect and/or Amazon Lex.

· Strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and microservices architectures.

· Experience with AWS services such as API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, SNS, SQS, and EventBridge.

· Experience using Git and GitHub for source control and CI/CD pipelines.

· Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.

· Understanding of secure software development practices and cloud security principles.

title: Jewelry Concept Designer
description:
I'm the founder of a story-driven accessories brand based in the US. We make intentional pieces — brooches, pins, and wearable art that communicate something. Think symbolic systems, cultural references, hidden messages. Not your typical jewelry brand.



I need a designer who can take a creative brief and come back with visual concepts 2-3 times per week — sketches, Procreate drafts, reference boards, whatever best communicates the idea. You're not designing final production files. You're helping me explore directions fast so I can react, push back, and refine until something is worth making.



What the work looks like

- I'll send you a brief. Could be a rough concept like: "African symbols/West African visual language turned into wearable brooch pins." You come back with 4-6 visual directions. We go back and forth. That's the loop.



You're a fit if:



- You have a portfolio showing accessories, jewelry, or wearable product sketches

- You're comfortable working from cultural/conceptual briefs, not just aesthetic ones

- You can use Procreate, Canva, or any sketch tool and deliver clean visual concepts

- You're fast and not precious about iteration — I give real feedback and expect you to move with it

- You're curious about symbolism, cultural design languages, and storytelling through objects



Hours: 5-10 hrs/week to start, with room to grow

Start: ASAP

To apply: Send your portfolio and a one-paragraph note about a piece of jewelry or accessory you find genuinely interesting and why.

title: Lovable Systems Builder | Vibe Coding, Web Design & Automations
description:
**Read the entire ad and make sure you put VIBE CODING in the subject line response so we know you read it.



We are looking for a talented systems builder who knows how to turn ideas into real, working software.



Craft House Systems builds custom business operating systems, websites, portals, dashboards, CRM systems, and automations for companies.



We are heavily using Lovable and AI-assisted development, and we need someone who can help us build faster, troubleshoot problems, create great-looking interfaces, and connect the different technologies behind our systems.



This is not a basic VA position.



We want someone who understands technology, has a strong eye for design, knows how systems connect, and enjoys figuring things out.



You do not need to be the world's best software engineer, but you should be comfortable working technically and solving problems without needing every step explained to you.



What You Will Help Us Build



Projects may include:



Custom business operating systems

Client portals

Internal company dashboards

CRM systems

Lead management systems

Customer onboarding systems

Scheduling systems

Business websites

Forms and intake systems

Membership platforms

AI-powered tools

Internal workflow automations

Integrations between different software platforms



We are building real systems businesses will use every day.



Platforms & Skills We Are Looking For



Strong experience in several of these areas is important:



Lovable

Vibe coding / AI-assisted development

Web design

UI/UX design

Front-end development

Basic or intermediate software engineering

Supabase

Databases

GoHighLevel

Zapier



Stripe integrations

Responsive website design

AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms



You do NOT need to be an expert in every tool listed.



However, you should be the type of person who can learn new platforms quickly, research a problem, test solutions, and keep moving until something works.



Who We Want



We are looking for someone who:



Thinks like a builder, not just a task taker

Can take an idea and help turn it into a working product

Has strong attention to detail

Understands good modern web design

Can troubleshoot technical problems

Is comfortable using AI to work faster

Can follow instructions but also make smart recommendations

Can communicate clearly when something is not working

Tests their work before saying it is finished

Is organized and dependable

Learns quickly

We especially want someone who enjoys figuring things out.



Sometimes you may receive a detailed build request.



Other times, we may explain what the business needs and expect you to help determine the best way to build it.



Design Matters



Technical skills alone are not enough.



The systems and websites we build need to look clean, modern, premium, and professional.



You should have a strong eye for:



Layout

Spacing

Typography

Mobile responsiveness

User experience

Navigation

Dashboard design

Modern website design



We do not want websites or systems that look like generic templates.



Work Schedule



This is currently a part-time position with the opportunity for additional hours and increased responsibility as we grow.



Our company is located in the Washington, DC area in the United States, and we operate on Eastern Time.



You do not necessarily need to work the entire Eastern Time schedule, but you must have some reliable overlap with our working hours for communication, meetings, testing, and project collaboration.



Growth Opportunity



We are building Craft House Systems into a company that develops operating systems and technology for businesses across multiple industries.



For the right person, this can grow into a long-term role with increased responsibility and involvement in larger client projects.

title: Executive Assistant for US Agency Founders
description:
We are a US-based digital marketing agency looking for an executive assistant who catches the things that would otherwise slip. This role requires 3 to 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.



Role summary:



You are the operational safety net. You listen to what was said in meetings and on
, turn it into tracked commitments, and make sure nothing gets dropped. You own the master calendar of internal and external deadlines, process leads captured at events into our systems, coordinate executive schedules, and prepare documents for send-off.





Responsibilities:



 • Review meeting recordings and transcripts in our meeting archive tool, produce action-item summaries with owners and due dates, and track them to closure

 • Maintain a single running schedule of all internal and external dates, deadlines, and deliverables, and publish it to the team on a set cadence

 • Post-event lead processing: take photographed business cards or spreadsheets and get every contact into the
 platform, tagged and segmented by event name and date, with full details logged in the CRM

 • Manage and coordinate two executive calendars, including scheduling, rescheduling, and conflict resolution

 • Research and surface industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities that match stated business priorities

 • Format, update, and prepare contracts and proposals for send-off, working from existing templates

 • Draft billing reminders and client payment request
s for approval

 • Maintain CRM hygiene: deduplicate, complete records, update stages

 • Keep the project management board current and chase overdue items

 • Monitor and draft responses for a business networking platform inbox, in the voice we specify





Must have:



 • 3 or more years supporting executives or business owners, ideally in a US-facing role

 • Willing and able to work 3 to 4 hours daily inside US Eastern business hours. This is not negotiable and is the most common reason applicants are declined

 • Excellent written English. You will draft correspondence that goes to US clients

 • Strong Google Workspace skills, particularly Sheets. You should be comfortable with lookups, filters, and cleaning a messy contact export

 • Experience with a CRM and an
 marketing platform

 • Extremely high attention to detail on names, dates, dollar amounts, and spelling

 • Discretion. You will see contracts, financials, and client correspondence

Nice to have

 • Experience with meeting transcription tools

 • Experience with a project management tool such as Asana

 • Experience preparing proposals or contracts for signature

 • Accounts receivable or collections support experience



To apply, send the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.



 1. Two work samples with all confidential information removed: one meeting summary or action-item tracker you produced, and one calendar, deadline tracker, or process document you built and maintained.

 2. Two professional references from past employers. References from companies based in the United States are strongly preferred. References from Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, or New Zealand are also accepted. At least one reference must be an executive or manager you directly supported.

 3. Your exact available working hours, stated in both Philippine time and US Eastern time.

 4. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

 5. Written confirmation that you consent to Hubstaff time tracking.



Start your application with the words GREEN FOLDER on the first line. Applications without it are deleted unread.



Screening questions

 1. State your working hours in US Eastern time. 

 2. You are in a meeting recording where three commitments are made but no one assigns owners or dates. What do you do next?

 3. You receive 60 photographed business cards from a conference. Describe your process end to end.

 4. A client is 30 days past due. Draft the first reminder
 you would send for approval.

 5. Describe a time you caught something that was about to be missed. What was it and how did you catch it?

 6. In Google Sheets, you have an event contact export with duplicate
s, inconsistent name capitalization, and mixed phone formats. How do you clean it? 

 7. What other work do you currently have and how many hours does it take weekly?

title: Senior Serviced Accommodation VA
description:
Senior Serviced Accommodation VA (Uplisting, SuiteOp, Turno) UK Property Management



Full time, long term (this is not a project or a trial gig)



SALARY



?40,000 to ?50,000 per month, depending on experience and how well you know our systems.



We pay above market because we expect above market. If you are a general admin VA looking to learn serviced accommodation, this is not your role. If you have run a UK or US short let portfolio before and can prove it, we want to hear from you.



HOURS



Shift based, aligned to UK time. Our operation runs 7am to 11pm UK time, 7 days a week, and we cover it with a rotating shift pattern. You will work 8 hours per day, 5 days per week, with a fixed schedule agreed in advance and a weekend rotation shared across the team.



Your shift will fall inside UK daytime and evening hours. Please only apply if you are genuinely happy working to UK time long term.



ABOUT US



Valstays is a UK serviced accommodation and Airbnb management company. We manage properties across the whole of the UK. We work with landlords, property investors and developers, and we run both a full management model and our own rent to rent portfolio.



We are a small, fast moving team. Our VAs are not order takers, they run the day to day operation. You will work directly with our team lead and our founders, and you will have real ownership of your shift.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



Guest communication



Handling all guest messages across Airbnb, 
, Vrbo and direct enquiries during your shift

Responding fast, in clear written English, in our brand tone

Managing check in and check out communication, access instructions and troubleshooting

Resolving complaints and issues calmly before they become reviews

Converting OTA guests to direct bookings using our SOP



Bookings and revenue



Processing enquiries, quoting, and confirming bookings

Managing extensions, amendments, cancellations and relocations

Handling deposits and damage waivers through our system

Flagging pricing and availability issues



Cleaning and turnovers



Scheduling and monitoring cleans in Turno

Chasing cleaners, confirming completion, checking photo evidence

Rebooking and escalating failed or late cleans so no guest ever walks into a dirty property

Managing linen and consumables stock alerts



Maintenance



Logging and triaging maintenance issues

Coordinating contractors, booking access, chasing completion

Keeping the owner or landlord informed where relevant



Admin and systems



Keeping property data, listings and SOPs accurate in Notion

Completing a written end of shift handover for the incoming VA every single day

Flagging broken automations and process gaps rather than working around them

TECH STACK



You must have hands on experience with at least three of these:



Uplisting (or a comparable PMS such as Hostaway, Guesty or Hospitable)

SuiteOp

Turno (or Properly / Breezeway)

Notion

Slack

Airbnb, 
 and Vrbo host dashboards



Bonus if you have used:



Zapier

Brevo

PriceLabs or Wheelhouse

Stripe



Tell us honestly what you have used and for how long. We will test it.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

2 or more years working in short term rentals or serviced accommodation, ideally for a UK or US portfolio

Excellent written English. Our guests are UK based professionals, contractors and families, and your messages represent our brand

Genuinely fast. Guest response time matters more here than almost anything else

Calm under pressure. A failed clean at 4pm on a Friday should make you move, not freeze

Proactive. You spot the problem before it lands in the inbox

Reliable internet, backup connection, and a quiet place to work

Comfortable being measured on numbers: response time, review scores, turnover failures

THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You are juggling multiple clients and this would be one of several

You need someone to tell you what to do every hour

You have done general admin or social media VA work and want to move into property

You cannot commit to UK hours long term

You wait to be asked before flagging something that has gone wrong

WHAT WE OFFER

Long term, stable, full time role with a growing company

Weekly pay 

Paid time off (with suitable notice before hand)

Clear SOPs and systems that actually work

Real progression

A team that does not micromanage but does expect standards

HOW TO APPLY



Applications that do not follow these instructions will be deleted without reading. This is the first test.



1. Put this exactly as your subject line: VALSTAYS SA VA 2026



2. In your application, answer these four questions directly. Short answers are fine, we are looking for clarity not essays.



Which property management system have you used, for how long, and how many units were you managing?

List every tool from our tech stack above that you have used, with a rating of 1 to 5 for each.

A guest is due to check in at 8pm. At 6pm the cleaner messages to say she cannot get into the property. Tell us exactly what you do, in order, in the next two hours.

What are your salary expectations in PHP per month, and what UK hours can you commit to?



3. Record a 2 minute video or voice recording introducing yourself and telling us about the most difficult guest situation you have handled and how it ended. Send us the link.



4. Tell us your fastest available start date and your notice period.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
About Us

We are a high-end, rapidly scaling U.S.-based interior design firm that works with luxury real estate developers, builders, agents, and discerning homebuyers. Our approach blends luxury design with practical, turnkey solutions, leveraging curated vendor partnerships and photo-realistic 3D visualization. We operate at the intersection of high-end design, technology, and data-driven operations to maximize our reach and impact.



As we scale, we're building our own platform and tooling - not just to run the business internally, but for our partners, builders, and eventually buyers - rather than stitching together off-the-shelf software.



Role Overview

We're looking for a full-stack developer who builds custom applications and codes fast and well because they've made AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor part of how they build. You'll own real features end to end: schema, backend, frontend, deploy. You'll also write the real code that keeps our systems talking to each other automatically.



This role has real ownership and real scope. You'll work closely with our team, earn trust quickly, and shape what this function looks like as we grow.



Key Responsibilities

* Product Development: Design and ship custom applications and features across our internal platform, partner-facing tools, and website, from schema through frontend through deploy

* AI-Accelerated Development: Use Claude Code and Cursor as your primary way of writing code, building faster while holding a higher bar

* Automation & Systems: Write the scripts, scheduled jobs, and workflow logic that move data automatically between our systems (client onboarding, vendor communications, project tracking, delivery), built entirely in code

What You Bring

* Proven, hands-on experience building custom full-stack web applications (a real frontend connected to a real backend and database) - show us what you've actually built

* The ability to look at any business process and design both the data model and the build sequence needed to solve it

* 3+ years in software development, ideally with real automation or scripting work as part of that experience

* Schedule flexibility to align with PT hours and team members in the Philippines

* Alignment with our company core values (listed below)



Our Company Core Values

RELATE: Humility, collaboration, and fun in everything we do

DISCOVER: Passion for innovation and continuous learning

DELIVER: Strong work ethic and personal accountability

DELIGHT: Commitment to exceptional client experiences

title: Graphic Designer – Static Ads & E-Commerce
description:
– Does This Sound Like You? –

You have a strong eye for modern design and know how to communicate ideas clearly through visuals.

You do not just want to create attractive graphics. You want to design creatives that capture attention, communicate a clear message, and contribute to measurable results.

At FUSSKLEIDUNG, your main focus will be creating static performance creatives for our paid advertising campaigns. You will also support the visual development of our brand across social media, our online store, landing pages, and other marketing channels.



– Your Responsibilities –

• Conceptualize and design static performance creatives for our paid social campaigns.

• Develop different creative concepts, designs, and variations for ongoing testing.

• Translate marketing messages, promotions, and product benefits into visually compelling advertisements.

• Collaborate with our marketing team to understand which creatives perform well and turn those insights into new design approaches.

• Create organic content for our social media channels.

• Design shop banners, product graphics, landing page elements, and other visual marketing materials.

• Continuously improve our visual brand identity and ensure a modern and consistent appearance across all channels.

• Work closely with our performance marketing, content, and e-commerce teams.

• Proactively contribute your own ideas and incorporate relevant design trends into our creative processes.



– What We Offer –

• 100% Remote Work: This is a fully remote position that allows you to work professionally from home.

• Visible Impact: Your designs will be used directly in our advertising campaigns, social media channels, and online store. You will be able to see how your work influences both our brand and our marketing performance.

• Creative Freedom: You will receive clear goals and structured briefs while still having room to develop your own visual ideas and approaches.

• Ownership Instead of Micromanagement: You will independently manage your tasks and take responsibility for the quality and timely delivery of your work.

• Direct and Honest Feedback: Our feedback is clear, constructive, and focused on improvement. We value open communication without unnecessary politics.

• Structured Work Environment: You will work with clear processes, established workflows, and defined creative strategies rather than constant chaos or unclear priorities.

• Meaningful Development: You will improve through real responsibility, regular feedback, and hands-on experience across different creative formats.

• Professional Software and Tools: We provide and cover the cost of all software, licenses, and digital tools required for your role, including Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and other necessary applications.

• Paid Time Off: You will receive 10 paid vacation days, 5 paid sick days, and 10 selected paid Philippine public holidays per year.



– Your Profile –

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Communication Design, Multimedia Arts, Fine Arts, Media Design, or a comparable creative field.

• You have relevant professional experience in graphic or media design, ideally within e-commerce, direct-to-consumer brands, or performance marketing.

• You have a strong understanding of aesthetics, typography, color, visual hierarchy, composition, and image selection.

• You can create designs that look modern and professional while also being clear and attention-grabbing.

• Ideally, you have already created static ads for Meta, social media campaigns, or other digital advertising channels.

• You understand that performance creatives must do more than look good. They must communicate a clear message and support measurable business results.

• You are highly proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or comparable professional design software.

• You can quickly understand different target audiences, products, offers, and communication angles.

• You work in a structured and reliable manner and can implement feedback quickly and carefully.

• You show initiative and are motivated to take responsibility for the visual development of a growing brand.

• A strong portfolio with relevant design samples is mandatory.



– Role Details –

• Contract Type: Full-time Independent Contractor

• Working Hours: 8 working hours per day plus a 45-minute unpaid break.

• Flexible Start Time: You can start your workday between 9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. Philippine Time. Your schedule should allow for sufficient collaboration and overlap with our team in Germany.

• Monthly Compensation: USD 1,000–1,200, depending on your experience and the quality of your portfolio.

• Work Setup: As this is a fully remote position, you must have your own reliable computer, a stable internet connection, and a suitable home-working environment. All professional software, licenses, and digital tools required for the role will be provided and paid for by FUSSKLEIDUNG.



– About Us –

FUSSKLEIDUNG is a direct-to-consumer outdoor footwear brand with more than one million customers across German-speaking Europe and annual revenue in the eight-figure range.

Our team currently consists of approximately 30 employees and continues to grow.

We have developed from a start-up into a structured e-commerce company with clear processes, defined responsibilities, and high standards for quality and execution.

We do not operate like a traditional retailer. We develop and manage our own products, from the initial idea through to marketing and sales.

Our day-to-day work is defined by ownership, reliability, and a strong focus on execution. We make data-driven decisions, work in a structured way, and move projects forward quickly.

At the same time, we still have ambitious plans. We see significant growth potential in our existing markets and plan to expand the FUSSKLEIDUNG brand internationally over the coming years.

This creates an environment with genuine ownership, meaningful creative freedom, and the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to actively shape the visual identity of FUSSKLEIDUNG and make a direct contribution to both our brand and our continued growth.



– How to Apply –

Please include the following in your application:

• Your current CV

• A link to your portfolio, including relevant examples of static ads, e-commerce designs, or social media creatives

• For selected portfolio projects, a brief note explaining your personal contribution

• Your earliest possible starting date

Applications without a relevant portfolio cannot be considered.

title: AI-Powered Focused Social Media Manager. Build Traffic. Drive Sales. Social Media Growth
description:
About the Role



Prodigy Media is looking for an AI Marketing Systems & Growth Manager to build the AI-powered marketing engine behind our brands.



This is not a traditional social media manager position. We need someone who understands marketing, but also thinks like a systems builder. You will use AI, automation, agents and creative technology to build repeatable systems that generate brand awareness, engagement, qualified traffic and sales.



We currently operate more than 10 brands. The initial focus will be on building one brand from the ground up, proving the system and producing measurable results. Once the model works, we will scale it across the rest of our portfolio.



The objective is straightforward: build an AI-powered marketing operation that drives customers to Shopify, grows TikTok Shop sales and creates additional demand that carries over to Amazon.



What You Will Build



You will be responsible for developing an interconnected marketing system that includes:



AI marketing agents and specialized subagents

Automated content research and production workflows

Social media content calendars and publishing systems

Short-form video and advertising production pipelines

TikTok, Instagram and
 growth systems

TikTok Shop customer acquisition campaigns

Shopify landing pages and conversion funnels

 capture, nurturing and promotional systems

Paid advertising campaigns across TikTok and Meta

Performance tracking, testing and optimization workflows

Systems for repurposing winning creative across multiple channels

Documentation that allows successful systems to be duplicated across additional brands

Use Claude Cowork as a primary workspace for building and operating marketing systems.

Build AI agents, subagents, skills, instructions and repeatable workflows for research, strategy, content creation, campaign execution and reporting.

Develop structured systems using Claude, Codex, Visual Studio or VS Code, APIs and automation platforms.

Connect tools and workflows so that marketing activities can be executed faster and with less repetitive manual work.

Maintain organized knowledge bases containing brand positioning, customer research, creative standards, winning content and campaign insights.

Continuously test new AI capabilities and determine how they can improve output, speed, consistency or profitability.





Social Media and Brand Growth

Build the brand’s presence across TikTok, Instagram and
.

Develop content strategies designed to generate awareness, engagement, followers, traffic and sales.

Research customer behavior, trends, competitors, hooks, formats and creative angles.

Create systems for producing and testing content consistently.

Build community engagement workflows that turn comments, conversations and customer feedback into growth opportunities.

Identify winning content and scale it across platforms without making every channel feel identical.





AI Creative Production

Produce AI-assisted product videos, UGC-style content, direct-response ads and branded creative.

Use tools such as Higgsfield, Claude Design, Codex and other emerging AI creative platforms.

Build repeatable creative pipelines covering concepts, scripts, storyboards, prompts, production, editing and variations.

Maintain brand consistency across characters, messaging, visual style, tone and offers.

Generate multiple creative variations quickly and use campaign data to determine what should be improved or scaled.





Paid Advertising and Customer Acquisition

Plan, launch and optimize advertising campaigns across TikTok and Meta.

Use paid traffic to drive customers to Shopify and TikTok Shop.

Develop campaign structures covering prospecting, retargeting, creative testing and offer testing.

Track performance metrics including CPM, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, CPA, ROAS and revenue.

Translate campaign results into clear creative and funnel improvements.

Understand how off-Amazon traffic and brand awareness can create additional demand for Amazon listings.





Shopify, Landing Pages and
 Marketing

Build and improve Shopify landing pages designed around specific audiences, problems and offers.

Create conversion-focused product pages, advertorials, lead-generation pages and promotional funnels.

Build
 capture, welcome, abandoned-cart, post-purchase, educational and promotional sequences.

Use testing and customer behavior data to improve conversion rates and customer value.

Ensure messaging remains consistent from the advertisement through the landing page, checkout and follow-up communication.

What Success Looks Like



The first stage of this role will focus on one selected brand. Success will be measured by the ability to:



Build a functional AI-powered marketing system from the ground up.

Establish a consistent production pipeline for organic and paid creative.

Grow qualified engagement and brand awareness across social platforms.

Generate measurable Shopify and TikTok Shop traffic and sales.

Improve advertising performance through disciplined testing.

Build landing pages and
 systems that convert traffic into customers.

Identify repeatable strategies that can be documented and scaled across our other brands.

Reduce the time and manual effort required to research, create, launch and optimize campaigns.





Required Experience

Proven experience marketing products through TikTok, Instagram and
.

Practical experience with TikTok Shop and direct-response e-commerce marketing.

Experience running or supporting TikTok Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

Understanding of Shopify, landing pages, conversion funnels and
 marketing.

Strong knowledge of short-form content, hooks, creative testing and social media engagement.

Experience using AI tools to produce marketing content, creative assets or automated workflows.

Ability to analyze performance data and make decisions based on results.

Strong written communication, organization and documentation skills.

Ability to work independently, move quickly and take ownership of outcomes.





Strongly Preferred

Advanced experience with Claude, particularly Claude Cowork.

Experience building agents, subagents, skills, prompts and multi-step AI workflows.

Working knowledge of Codex, Visual Studio or VS Code, APIs, MCP connections and automation tools.

Experience creating AI-generated videos and advertisements with Higgsfield or similar platforms.

Experience building and scaling a consumer brand outside Amazon.

Experience connecting social media, paid advertising, Shopify,
 and Amazon into one customer-acquisition strategy.

Familiarity with Amazon private-label brands and the relationship between external demand and Amazon sales.

Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who believes marketing has fundamentally changed and wants to operate at the forefront of that change.



You should be excited by the opportunity to combine marketing strategy, AI systems, automation, content production and paid advertising. You do not need to know every platform on day one, but you must be willing to learn quickly, experiment intelligently and turn new capabilities into real business results.



You are likely a strong fit if you:

Understand that impressive creative means nothing if it does not generate attention, traffic or sales.

Are energized by change instead of threatened by it.

Want access to advanced AI tools and the freedom to use them creatively.

Are ready for a serious challenge with the opportunity to shape how multiple brands are built and marketed.



If you are up for a rewarding role with learning skills that will carry you beyond your role, please
 me directly with the subject line "I'm a Marketing Magician". to 



Regards,

Tam Ma

Co Founder, Prodigy Media
